title: Advanced Video Editor
description:
We are looking for an Advanced Video Editor who can create high-quality, engaging, and conversion-focused video content for multiple platforms, including YouTube, Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, ads, and website content.

This role is ideal for someone who understands not only how to edit videos beautifully, but also how to use pacing, storytelling, hooks, captions, music, sound design, graphics, and platform-specific formatting to keep viewers engaged and drive action.

The ideal candidate is highly skilled in video editing software, has strong creative judgment, can work independently, and understands how video content supports marketing, branding, lead generation, and audience growth.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Video Editing & Production

-Edit long-form and short-form videos for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok,
, websites, ads, and other digital platforms.

-Create engaging intros, hooks, transitions, captions, B-roll sequences, motion graphics, and outros.

-Repurpose long-form video content into short-form clips for social media.

-Edit talking-head videos, interviews, testimonials, educational videos, promotional videos, and ad creatives.

-Clean up audio, balance sound levels, add music, sound effects, and improve overall production quality.

-Color correct and color grade footage to maintain a professional and consistent look.

-Add subtitles, captions, lower thirds, callouts, icons, animations, and other visual elements where appropriate.

Format videos correctly for different platforms, including vertical, square, and landscape versions.



2. Storytelling & Creative Direction

-Turn raw footage into compelling stories with clear structure, strong pacing, and emotional impact.

-Identify the best moments from long recordings and turn them into engaging clips.

-Improve viewer retention through strong hooks, pattern interrupts, clean pacing, and visual variety.

-Suggest creative improvements to make content more engaging and professional.

-Understand the purpose of each video, whether it is for brand awareness, education, lead generation, trust-building, or conversion.



3. Social Media & Marketing Support

-Edit videos optimized for platform performance, including YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and paid ads.

-Create content that aligns with brand voice, target audience, and marketing goals.

-Add clear calls-to-action when appropriate.

-Help transform educational or informational content into engaging, shareable video assets.

-Stay updated on video trends, editing styles, social media formats, and best practices.



4. Workflow & Collaboration

-Work with the marketing team, content team, or business owner to understand video goals and creative direction.

-Organize raw footage, project files, audio files, graphics, and final exports.

-Follow brand guidelines for fonts, colors, logo usage, tone, and visual style.

-Manage multiple video projects and meet deadlines consistently.

-Accept feedback professionally and revise edits as needed.

-Maintain clear communication about project status, timelines, and questions.



Requirements



Technical Skills

-Advanced experience with professional video editing software such as:

-Adobe Premiere Pro

-Final Cut Pro

-DaVinci Resolve

-After Effects

-CapCut

or similar tools

-Strong knowledge of video formats, codecs, frame rates, aspect ratios, and export settings.

-Ability to edit both long-form and short-form content.

-Experience with motion graphics, animated text, captions, transitions, and visual effects.

-Strong audio editing skills, including noise reduction, volume balancing, music selection, and sound effects.

-Understanding of color correction and color grading.

-Ability to create platform-specific edits for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok,
, and paid ads.

-Ability to work with raw footage, screen recordings, interviews, podcasts, webinars, and social media clips.



Creative Skills

-Strong sense of pacing, rhythm, storytelling, and visual composition.

-Ability to create strong hooks in the first few seconds of a video.

-Good judgment for choosing the best clips, visuals, music, and transitions.

-Ability to make videos feel polished, engaging, and professional.

-Understanding of how video editing impacts viewer retention and conversion.

-Ability to follow brand style while also suggesting creative improvements.



Professional Skills

-Excellent attention to detail.

-Strong communication skills.

-Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

-Ability to manage deadlines and multiple projects.

-Open to feedback and able to revise quickly.

-Reliable, organized, and proactive.

-Comfortable working remotely with digital project management tools.



Preferred Qualifications

-Experience editing videos for coaches, consultants, agencies, service businesses, personal brands, or online businesses.

-Experience editing YouTube videos, YouTube Shorts, TikToks, Instagram Reels, and
 Reels.

-Experience with direct-response video ads or conversion-focused social media content.

-Experience using AI tools for video editing, transcription, captions, B-roll, thumbnails, or workflow automation.

-Experience creating video thumbnails or working with designers on thumbnail concepts.

-Basic understanding of social media marketing, audience retention, and content strategy.



Experience with tools such as:

-Descript

-OpusClip

-Canva

-Photoshop



-ClickUp

-Trello

-Google Drive

-Dropbox

-Notion

-Ability to create simple motion graphics in After Effects or similar tools.

-Experience editing testimonial videos, case studies, webinars, podcasts, and educational content.

-Basic understanding of YouTube SEO and social media content optimization.

title: Content Assistant + Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Part-Time, Ongoing | Remote



// About the Role //



I run House of Agalliao, a growing hair and beauty brand focused on custom wig making and wig education.



I’m looking for a creative Content Assistant + Short-Form Video Editor who can help me turn the content I create into engaging, intentional social media content while also helping me become more organized and consistent with content creation.



This is primarily an editing role, with content assistance as the secondary responsibility.



I’m not looking for someone who only waits for instructions and completes tasks exactly as assigned. I want someone who can eventually learn the brand, understand my personality and creative preferences, help me develop a recognizable content style, and bring ideas to me too.



You do not need to know everything about my brand or industry on day one. I’m looking for someone who is observant, creative, reliable and willing to learn.



// Who I’m Looking For //



You may be a great fit if you’re very online and naturally aware of what’s happening across Instagram, TikTok and internet culture in general.



You understand current content trends, conversations, memes, sounds, editing styles and emerging formats — but you also understand that following every trend doesn’t automatically make good content.



You should be a strong short-form video editor with a good eye for pacing, storytelling, text placement, music, sound effects, transitions and visual details.



You should be comfortable editing Instagram Reels, TikToks and other vertical short-form content and be able to do basic photo editing or simple graphics when needed.



I’m especially interested in someone who can see potential in raw footage that may not immediately look exciting.



You should also be able to study another person’s personality and gradually understand their voice, sense of humor, preferences and audience.



Good content should do more than look pretty. It should hold attention, communicate something and ultimately support the business.



I want someone proactive enough to say:



“I saw this trend and think we could adapt it this way.”



Or:



“You mentioned this while filming — I think that could actually be its own Reel.”



Or:



“For next week, I need you to record these three clips and I can turn them into these content ideas.”



You should be organized, reliable with deadlines, consistent with communication, comfortable receiving feedback and capable of working independently once you have proper direction.



I don’t expect you to know everything. I do expect you to be resourceful enough to research, experiment and figure things out.



// What You’ll Help With //



Your responsibilities may include:



* Editing Instagram Reels, TikToks and other short-form videos; reviewing raw footage and identifying the strongest moments; developing pacing and storytelling within edits; adding appropriate on-screen text, subtitles, sound effects, music, screenshots, graphics, B-roll or visual elements; cleaning up audio; finding appropriate sounds or music; repurposing existing or older content; finding opportunities to turn one recording into multiple pieces of content; researching trends, creators, hooks and content formats; bringing new content concepts to me; organizing raw footage and completed content; helping maintain a content calendar; creating simple shot lists or recording requests for me; tracking content that needs to be recorded, edited, revised or published; helping prepare content for posting; and helping me build a more consistent content creation process.



My current goal is approximately 3–5 quality pieces of content per week.



I care much more about creating content that feels intentional, engaging and on-brand than posting filler just to say we posted something.



// My Editing Style + Creative Direction //



I don’t currently have one rigid or fully established editing style.



Most of the content I create myself is relatively simple — clean cuts, occasional on-screen text or captions, music, sound effects and small visual details.



But I would like my content to become more visually engaging, creative and recognizable over time.



Part of why I’m hiring for this role is because I want someone who can help me develop that style with me.



I already have a strong sense of what I like and, equally important, what I don’t like.



I want someone with enough creative instinct to take those preferences, study my personality and brand, experiment with different approaches, and gradually help establish an editing style that feels distinctly like House of Agalliao and me.



Eventually, I would love for there to be certain visual elements, editing choices or creative touches that people begin to recognize as part of my content — without making every video look exactly the same.



I am not looking for someone who simply adds captions, random effects and transitions to every video and considers it finished.



I like content that feels:



Clean. Current. Personality-driven. Engaging. Intentional.



Sometimes the strongest edit may be very simple.



Other times a video might benefit from humor, sound effects, screenshots, B-roll, text, visual references, interesting cuts or other creative elements that strengthen the story.



I want someone with enough creative judgment to understand the difference.



I also don’t want an editor who applies the exact same editing template or style to every client.



I want someone willing to experiment, learn what works for my audience, take feedback and help us develop our own visual identity over time.



// Brand Voice //



You’ll be working with content that represents both me personally and House of Agalliao, so understanding my personality will be important.



My content tends to be conversational, confident, relatable, educational and sometimes funny.



I don’t want my content to feel overly corporate, robotic, cheesy or obviously written by a social media assistant.



You are not expected to understand my voice perfectly on day one.



What matters more is whether you are observant enough to learn it.



I want someone who pays attention to the way I naturally speak, the phrases I use, what I find funny, how I explain things and how I communicate with my audience — and gradually becomes better at helping me create content that still sounds and feels like me.



Beauty + Hair Industry Understanding



Previous experience in the hair industry is a plus, but it is not required.



However, you must be interested and willing to learn.



My content involves wig making, wig education, beauty entrepreneurship and the behind-the-scenes process of running and growing a beauty brand.



You will encounter terminology surrounding things like closures, bundles, knots, glueless wigs, wig construction and other aspects of the hair industry.



I don’t need someone pretending to already know everything.



I would rather have someone curious enough to ask questions, learn the terminology and understand the audience than someone treating the content like generic beauty content.



// Content Assistance //



Editing is the primary part of this role, but I’m also looking for someone who can help make content creation feel less overwhelming for me.



There may be weeks when I have a lot of footage ready to edit and weeks when I have less.



During lighter editing periods, your work may shift toward researching content ideas, reviewing older footage for repurposing opportunities, organizing content, identifying trends or references, planning upcoming concepts, creating shot lists and helping determine what I should record next.



I don’t want the entire content process to stop just because I haven’t handed you a new video yet.



Part of the long-term goal is for this role to actually help me become a more consistent content creator.



Eventually, I want us to reach a point where you might come to me and say:



“Here are four ideas for next week. For this one, I just need you to record yourself doing this. For this one, answer this question on camera. And for this one, I can use footage we already have.”



That level of initiative is something I would really value.



// Schedule + Workload //



This is an ongoing part-time position with a flexible workload.



I currently expect the role to be somewhere around 10–15 hours per week, although workload may vary depending on how much content is being created.



Some weeks may be more editing-heavy than others.



I’m looking for someone who wants an ongoing working relationship rather than someone who only wants occasional one-off editing projects.



There is also potential for the role, responsibilities and hours to grow over time as the brand grows.



// Bonus Points //



It’s a plus if you have previously edited content for beauty, hair, fashion, education, creator-led or personal brands.



It’s also a plus if you understand basic content marketing, storytelling or consumer psychology; understand why someone might stop scrolling or continue watching a piece of content; know how to repurpose one recording into multiple pieces of content; have experience with tools such as CapCut, Canva and Google Drive; understand the difference between founder-led content and highly polished corporate content; or naturally come across something online and think:



“We could do our version of this.”



That kind of creative instinct is exactly what I’m interested in.



// How to Apply //



Please send me a short introduction telling me about yourself and why this specific role caught your attention.



Please also include 3–5 examples of short-form videos you personally edited. Send me the work you think best represents your abilities rather than everything you’ve ever edited.



If you have a portfolio, please include it.



Tell me which editing software and tools you primarily use, your current availability, your timezone, and your expected hourly or monthly rate.



(Optional but recommended): I’d also like you to tell me one creator or brand whose social media content you think is really good right now — and why you think their content works.



I’m interested in your answer because I want to understand your creative taste and the way you think about content, not just whether you technically know how to use editing software.



Please do not send a generic copy-and-paste application.



I’m much more interested in your creative taste, attention to detail, reliability, communication, initiative and ability to understand a brand than receiving the perfect résumé.

title: Senior Technical SEO Specialist
description:
About Us



MediaJel is a dynamic software technology startup company specializing in the digital marketing space with a dedicated team of professionals on an exciting growth trajectory. 



About the Role:



This is a hands-on senior role, not an advisory one. You will own technical SEO for our website and for a portfolio of product sites, and you will be the person the team escalates to when something is not indexing, not ranking, or not tracking.



We are hiring on a 3-month contract with the intent to convert to full-time. The first 90 days are scoped around clear deliverables.



The sites you will work in are mostly 
 includes a growing library of blog and educational content, a marketing academy, webinar and resource pages, and templated page sets covering advertising regulations in all 50 states. You will be the sole technical SEO owner, working alongside our marketing, content, demand generation, and web teams.



We are looking for a highly experienced and qualified Technical Search Engine Optimization (SEO)  Specialist in a senior role:



What You Will Own



Technical health of 
: crawlability, indexation, canonical logic, redirects, sitemaps, robots directives, pagination, and URL parameter handling

Structured data end to end. Writing, deploying, validating, and monitoring JSON-LD across the site, including Organization, Article, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, Course, Event, and Service types

Internal linking architecture. Building and maintaining pillar and cluster models, hub-and-spoke link maps, anchor text strategy, link equity distribution, and orphan page remediation as new content publishes

Site architecture and URL taxonomy, including large templated page sets such as our state-by-state regulatory library

Keyword cannibalization analysis and remediation. Identifying competing pages and making consolidate, rewrite, redirect, or retain decisions, then executing them

Core Web Vitals and page experience. Diagnosing root causes such as render-blocking assets, background video, image weight, and third-party scripts, then specifying fixes the web team can implement

Indexation of JavaScript-rendered and embedded content

Pre-launch and post-launch QA for redesigns, template changes, and URL migrations, including redirect mapping and monitoring

Measurement infrastructure. GA4, Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager configuration, event and conversion tracking, and reporting that leadership can read at a glance

Monthly and quarterly technical audits with prioritized, effort-scored recommendations, followed through to completion

White-hat link acquisition, including digital PR, resource and citation placements, and unlinked mention reclamation

Optimization for AI search surfaces, including AI Overviews and LLM citation, with attention to entity clarity and content structured for extraction

Technical QA of published content: schema present and valid, internal links in place, templates rendering correctly, and no thin or duplicate output



Required Experience



5 or more years in SEO, with at least 3 years concentrated in technical SEO

Demonstrated ownership of a site of 500 or more pages

Advanced Screaming Frog skills, including custom extraction, JavaScript rendering mode, API integration, and crawl comparison analysis

Strong command of Semrush, specifically Site Audit, Position Tracking, Backlink Audit, and cannibalization reporting

Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console including bulk export or API access, and Google Tag Manager

Working knowledge of HTML and CSS, and enough JavaScript to diagnose rendering issues



Skills

Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical issues to executives in plain language and to developers with implementation-level precision

Comfortable operating independently and setting priorities without daily direction

Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage concurrent workstreams and deliver on deadline

Collaborative and proactive partner to content, demand generation, and web teams

Current on the search landscape, including how AI-driven search is changing organic visibility



Details



Remote, with overlap in Pacific Time Zone business hours

3-month contract with the opportunity to convert to full-time



How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with one brief example of a technical SEO issue you diagnosed and resolved, including what was wrong, the action you took, and the measurable result. A link, screenshot, or short written summary is sufficient. Examples help us move qualified candidates forward quickly.

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines-based VAs only)



Read this whole thing before you apply. If you skim it, you'll fail step one.



Smartland manages 1,400+ rental homes and apartments. The CEO moves fast and d
 faster. This role exists to make him faster still: to remove friction, anticipate the next three steps, and never let a ball drop. You are his memory, his logic check, and his second brain.





This is not a calendar-and-coffee job. If that's what you're looking for, stop here.



What you'll actually do:



Run the CEO's day so he doesn't have to think about logistics: calendar, travel, prep, follow-through.

Catch things before they become problems. We expect you to flag what we missed.

Hold the full picture in your head: who owes what, what's due when, which thread is still open.

Turn vague direction into a finished result without being walked through it.

Build and maintain checklists for everything, because nothing falls through a good checklist.



Who we're looking for:



You think fast and you think clearly. Sloppy logic is a dealbreaker.

Your memory is sharp. People are surprised by what you remember.

You are relentlessly organized. You love checklists, genuinely, not as a line on a résumé.

You're proactive. You'd rather ask forgiveness than wait for instructions on the obvious.

You think strategically. You see why a task matters, not just what the task is.

When the standard template doesn't fit, you build a better one.



Do not apply if:



You need detailed instructions to start.

You've ever said "that's not my job."

You drop tasks and blame the volume.

You're hoping to wing it. We will find out by week one.



English Communication Requirement



Candidates must have strong English communication skills, with a minimum expected level of B2; C1 is preferred.



You should be able to communicate clearly and professionally in both written and spoken English, understand instructions accurately, and communicate effectively with clients, prospects, and internal team members.



An English proficiency test result is not required at the time of application. However, Smartland may request proof of English proficiency later in the hiring process, including after the interview, if needed.



English proficiency will be evaluated throughout the screening and interview process.



Please do not apply if you do not feel confident communicating professionally in English at a B2 level or higher.

title: Social Media Content Producer (x3)
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Philippines Based



You watch a 10-minute video and immediately see the 15-second hook, the YouTube cut, three Reels, a blog angle, and the Reddit post.



You understand modern editing, hooks, pacing, captions, thumbnails, titles, and platform culture. You stay current without blindly chasing trends or making everything feel over-edited or corny.



Most importantly, you have TASTE.



If that's how your brain works, keep reading.



## Who We Are



Rareform Audio is a music and audio company specializing in music for movie trailers, advertising, film, TV, games, and content.



We're building a small team of creators, editors, and social-media natives who can each take ownership of a different content lane.



When you apply, tell us which role you're applying for:



**The Foundry | Music Products & Composer Content**



Our brand new product company creating professional instruments and sounds for composers and music producers. **Music production experience is required.** You'll work inside a DAW using our instruments and sounds, play through and demonstrate products, screen record content, and turn those sessions into videos and posts for composers and producers.



**Nathan Fields | Personal Brand Content**



Long-form and short-form content around composing, music production, sound design, entrepreneurship, the music business, and building creative companies. You'll turn long-form content into clips, posts, blogs, and platform-specific content while helping develop new ideas.



**Rareform PM | Creator & Music Platform Content**



Our production music platform for content creators. You'll create daily videos, clips, blogs, and educational content around music for creators, including topics like scoring your own content, choosing music, and improving videos with sound. This position may begin within the next 1–2 months, but we're interested in meeting the right people now.



## The Role



We don't want someone who needs a detailed checklist for every post. We want a creative who can eventually know their content lane better than we do.



You'll create and repurpose content across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, and our websites. That includes short and long-form video, blogs, thumbnails, graphics, captions, titles, and platform-specific posts.



Just as importantly, you'll bring us ideas, identify opportunities we're missing, and help determine what we should be making, not just execute what you're given.



## What We're Looking For



- Strong modern video editing skills

- Great instincts for hooks, pacing, retention, and storytelling

- Strong writing and social media copy

- A sharp visual eye and good design taste

- Deep understanding of current social platforms and trends

- Ability to turn one idea or piece of content into multiple formats

- Highly organized and able to maintain a consistent posting schedule

- Self-directed, creative, proactive, and comfortable bringing your own ideas



**Taste matters.** We want content that feels current, premium, creative, and human. We don't want unnecessary zooms, giant captions, sound effects, and transitions just because they're trending. Know when those things make the content better and when they don't.



## Who Fits Our Team



We build our team around infinite learners, self-directed problem solvers, and people with high standards of excellence.



Trustworthy. Driven. Accountable. Curious. Creative.



If you need to be told exactly what to do every day or see social media as a mechanical posting job, this isn't the right role.



## How to Apply



Apply here only:




/
social-media



You'll need to include a 3–5 minute Loom video with your application.



Don't make it a generic introduction. Show us what you've done.



In your Loom:



1. Tell us which role you're applying for. If you're a strong fit for more than one, tell us.

2. Show us your best previous work: videos, accounts, campaigns, blogs, thumbnails, brands, etc.

3. Pick something you've created and walk us through your creative decisions. What was the hook? Who was the audience? Why did you approach it that way?

4. Tell us how you would approach this role. What would you create, post, test, or improve?

5. Tell us why we should trust you to eventually own this content lane.



If you're applying for The Foundry, show us your music production skills too. Open your DAW, show us something you've made, and tell us about your production experience.



Include links to your strongest previous work as well.



Applications without a Loom video and examples of previous work will not be reviewed.

Who We Are



Rareform Audio and Black Sheep Music are a music and sound company specializing in music for movie trailers, advertising, film, TV, and media. We create and license music for major campaigns around the world, and we work with clients who often need things quickly, clearly, and professionally.



We are a small company, so people on our team often wear multiple hats depending on their strengths. We like growing with the people we invest in. More than anything, we are looking for someone sharp, reliable, accountable, detail-oriented, and eager to learn.



The Role



We are looking for a Music Coordinator / Admin Assistant to help coordinate projects between our clients and our internal team.



This is not a high-level music supervisor role. You do not need to be an expert in trailer music, playlisting, or music licensing. Music production skills are a huge plus, but they are not required.



The most important thing is that you are organized, trustworthy, responsive, and able to help keep things moving.



You will help with client requests, stem deliveries, project notes, team follow-ups, file organization, and general coordination. Over time, the role may grow based on your strengths.



Hours



The required schedule is Monday-Friday, 5am-12pm Philippines time, which is 2pm-9pm Los Angeles time during daylight savings.



This gives us overlap with Los Angeles clients and allows us to handle time-sensitive requests while the U.S. workday is still active.



What You’ll Help With



- Coordinating client requests between our clients and team

- Helping with stem requests, instrumentals, alternate mixes, and file deliveries

- Organizing project details, notes, links, files, and follow-ups

- Communicating clearly with our internal team of composers and roster of talent

- Making sure requests do not fall through the cracks

- Helping with basic admin, research, and outreach tasks when needed

- Supporting Rareform Audio and Black Sheep Music across different projects



What We’re Looking For



- An infinite learner

- Excellent written English

- Strong attention to detail

- Reliable and accountable

- Organized and able to track multiple moving pieces

- Comfortable with Gmail, Notion, Dropbox and online tools

- Able to follow instructions carefully

- Able to work independently once trained

- Interested in music, media, trailers, film, TV, advertising, or creative work

- Willing to learn new systems and improve over time



Musical experience is a plus, especially if you produce music, sing, play an instrument, edit videos, create content, or have worked around artists, labels, studios, playlists, or music promotion. But the main thing we need is someone sharp who can help us coordinate and stay organized.

title: Medical Care Coordinator & Program Accountability Coach — Eczema Practice (Long-Term, Medical Experience Required)
description:
Job overview:



Type: Part-time, 22–24 hours a week, growing with us 

Pay: $7–9/hour depending on experience — 22–24 hours a week, roughly $665–855 a month

Hours: 8:00am–12:00pm Pacific, Monday to Friday. Monday starts 2–4 hours earlier. 

Skills: Healthcare admin, excellent spoken and written English, careful and warm



Please read this part first:



I've posted a couple of roles recently and I'm replacing both of them with this one.



I'd been looking for two people — someone to coordinate care, and someone separate to support our members week to week. Having talked to a lot of candidates, it's clear this should be one job. The person who books the appointments, sends the lab kits, and knows who hasn't collected theirs is the same person who should be reading our members' journals. Nobody coming to it cold could write anything useful.



So this is one role, more hours, and a better job than either of the two it replaces. I'm also being much stricter about who I'm asking to apply, because I had far more applications than I could work through last time — most from people with no healthcare background.



Please only apply if all three of these are true:



You have medical or healthcare experience — nursing, medical technology, pharmacy, healthcare administration, medical VA work, or similar

You can send a short video introduction, described at the bottom

The night shift genuinely works for your life, long-term



If any of those is a no, please don't apply. I'll only be reading applications that include the video and the writing sample, and I'd rather not waste your time.



A strong plus: experience or study in nutrition, wellness, or functional health.



If you applied to either of my earlier posts: this one replaces them both and I'm not working from those applications any more. If you meet the requirements above, please apply again here and follow all the steps at the bottom. I'll read it properly this time.



About us:



Hi — I'm Dr. Diane Angela Fong, a naturopathic doctor in California. I run Cleanbody, a practice and education program for people with severe eczema and other chronic diseases.



Most of the people who find us have been struggling for years. They've tried steroids, elimination diets, and a dozen creams that didn't work. By the time they reach us they're exhausted and they've mostly stopped believing anything will help.



We run lab testing to find what's actually driving their skin, then a twelve-week program to fix it. The program works — but only if people stay with it. And the hardest week isn't the first. It's week six, when their skin flares, they're discouraged, and nobody notices they've quietly stopped.



This role has two halves. Most of the week you keep the practice running. On Mondays, you're the person who notices.



Your week:



Monday — 6 to 8 hours. You start earlier and work through to noon Pacific. Messages pile up over the weekend, so you clear those first, then move on to the journals. If you don't finish them, they carry into Tuesday — better done properly than done fast.



Tuesday to Friday — 4 hours, 8:00am to 12:00pm Pacific. Coordination, callbacks, and any journals left over.



In Manila time that's 11:00pm–3:00am from March to November, and midnight–4:00am from November to March. 



The two halves:



Responsibility #1: Patient Care Coordination — every day



You keep everything moving so I can focus on patients.



Returning calls. We don't get many and most go to voi
 — your job is to call people back during the morning window. Appointment questions, kit questions, rescheduling.

Scheduling and rescheduling

Sending lab kits and tracking whether they've been collected and posted

Chasing the people who haven't collected. This is the single most common reason someone's care stalls, and preventing it is worth more than almost anything else you'll do.

Entering results into the chart when they arrive

Documenting supplement refills

Producing superbills on request

Issuing and revoking member discount codes

Answering routine questions by
 — never clinical ones



Responsibility #2: Accountability coaching — Mondays



Our members keep a journal each week: how they slept, what they ate, whether they took their supplements, how their skin feels. They submit by Sunday night.



Every Monday you read all of them and write back to each person. You tell them what they're doing well. You ask what's getting in the way. You remind them that week six is hard for almost everybody and that they're not behind.



Then you send me a short report: anything I need to know, who's gone quiet, who's stalled, the three questions that came up most, and one win worth reading out. I use that report to plan the live call I run mid-week, so what you send me shapes what our members hear.



I'll need that report by the end of your Tuesday shift.



Why this is one job and not two: you already know this member's results came back last week, that they've reordered twice, and that they cancelled a visit in October. Someone reading their journal cold couldn't write anything specific. You can.



The line you never cross:



You are not giving medical advice. Not on the phone, not in writing, not in either half of this role.



You never comment on symptoms, interpret a lab result, suggest a supplement, or answer a question about someone's protocol. That's my job and I'm the only one who can do it. I'll train you thoroughly on exactly where the line sits and give you approved wording for everything that comes up.



Safe: "You've logged six hours' sleep for two weeks — what's getting in the way?" Not safe: "Your flare might be the eggs." or "Maybe try half the dose."



You comment on what the person did, never on what their body is doing.



This is harder on a call than in writing, because someone will ask you directly and you'll want to help. You'll have a scripted answer ready for exactly that. Anything urgent reaches me automatically through our system, so you are never responsible for catching an emergency. Your job is noticing patterns, not crises — that's a relief, not a restriction.



What you need:



Required:



A medical or health background. Nursing, medical technology, pharmacy, nutrition, physical therapy, healthcare administration, or medical VA work. This is not negotiable — you'll be handling lab kits, results, and refill documentation, and you need to already understand what you're looking at.

Clear spoken English. You'll be calling patients in the US, and they need to understand you easily the first time.

Excellent written English — warm and natural, not stiff or formal

Genuinely careful. In this work, small errors matter.

Comfortable following a script and escalating rather than improvising

A headset and a quiet room for calls. Not a laptop microphone, not a shared space.

Reliable internet, and Mondays genuinely free — that's the day the week depends on

Able to commit long-term. This role grows as we grow.



Nice to have:



Personal or family experience with eczema, or another chronic skin condition. This matters more than anything else on this list. If you've lived with it, or watched someone you love live with it, you already understand something I can't teach.

Experience with an EHR or patient portal

Nutrition, wellness, or functional health — study or work experience. You'll be surrounded by this material and it helps enormously to already speak the language.

Social media or video editing. I publish a lot — YouTube, reels, a podcast — and if you can edit or schedule content, there's more work here for you and it's how this role grows fastest.



Not required:



Any US credential

Availability outside the morning window

Weekend or evening work — there is none



What it's like to work here:



We're small. We will be a two person team supporting our patients. I'm direct about what I need, I don't micromanage, and I would far rather you ask than guess.



I'm expecting a baby in March 2027 and I'll be on leave from March to June. During those four months you'll be the main point of contact our members have. That's exactly why I want to hire and train someone properly now rather than scrambling in February — and it's why I'm looking for someone who wants a long-term role rather than a stopgap.



There's a bonus in July 2027 for being here continuously through that period. I'd rather say that up front than hope.



Pay:

$7–9/hour depending on experience — 22–24 hours a week, roughly $665–855 a month

Paid twice monthly, in USD

13th month bonus, as standard

Paid 15-minute break each shift; 30-minute unpaid meal break on Mondays

Pay is reviewed as you take on more, and there are more hours available over time — particularly if you can help with content or if our patient and membership base grows



How to apply:



Please don't send a generic application — I read every one myself and I can tell. My website is www.cleanbody.health if you want more information about my practice before you complete these items.



Send me:



1. A short note about your background and why this kind of work appeals to you. Not your CV.



2. This writing sample. Here is a member's journal entry from their sixth week:



"Honestly this week was rough. My skin flared up worse than it's been in a month and I don't know why. I've been doing everything — I haven't had dairy in five weeks, I'm taking all the supplements, I'm sleeping better than I was. And it still got worse. I'm starting to wonder if this is worth it. I skipped my journal a few days because I didn't want to write it down."



Write your reply. Around 100–150 words. 



Remember: you're not a doctor. You cannot tell them why their skin flared, what to change, or whether the dairy is the problem. What you can do is notice what they've done, acknowledge how it feels, and help them keep going.



3. A short video — 2 minutes, no more. Just you talking to your phone camera. Tell me who you are and why you'd be good at this. It doesn't need to be polished; I'm not judging your lighting. I want to hear how you speak about people — and since you'll be calling patients, I need to hear you speak. 



If you or someone close to you has lived with eczema, tell me about that. It's the thing I most want to hear.



4. A subject line that starts with "ECZEMA" — then, in a few words, tell me why I should open your message.



Not "ECZEMA - Application" or "ECZEMA - Care Coordinator." Something real. ECZEMA — nurse, 6 years, my son has had it since he was two. ECZEMA — medtech, I read lab reports all day and I write well.



I'll be reading a lot of these. Your subject line is how you make sure yours isn't the one I skim.



5. Confirm the schedule works for you — 8am to 12pm Pacific, Monday to Friday, with an earlier start on Mondays. Tell me honestly whether nights suit your life.



Applications without the writing sample and the video won't be read. I'm sorry to be blunt about it — I've had hundreds of applications on previous posts and this is the only way I can give proper attention to the right ones.

title: Amazon Catalog Specialist (Seller Central, Listings, FBA & FBM) - PH Remote, Full-Time
description:
About Marie Originals



Marie Originals is a US-based, multi-brand DTC and B2B wellness and personal-care company selling across Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, and TikTok Shop. Amazon is our biggest channel, and the catalog is the foundation everything else runs on. If a listing is suppressed, mis-classified, or out of stock on the wrong fulfillment channel, we lose sales that no amount of advertising can win back. We are hiring an Amazon Catalog Specialist to own that foundation across both FBA and FBM.



This is a detail-heavy, systems-minded role. You will live in Seller Central and in flat files.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Listing creation and catalog builds

- Create new ASINs and full variation families (parent/child) for product launches using Amazon category templates and flat files.

- Manage GTIN/UPC assignment and exemptions, item type keywords, and correct browse node and category classification.

- Maintain accurate attributes across the catalog (size, dimensions, materials/ingredients fields, pack quantity, compliance fields).



FBA and FBM operations

- Own both fulfillment channels: keep FBA and FBM offers correctly set up, in stock, and live on the right ASINs.

- FBA: manage FNSKUs and labeling, build and track inbound shipment plans, clear stranded and unfulfillable inventory, file and chase reimbursement claims for lost or damaged units, and watch restock limits, IPI, and aged-inventory exposure.

- FBM: maintain shipping templates, handling time, and availability so merchant-fulfilled offers stay competitive, and coordinate dispatch with our warehouse and ShipStation flow.

- Protect the fulfillment metrics our listings depend on: late shipment rate, valid tracking rate, on-time delivery rate, and cancellation rate.

- Flag which SKUs belong on FBA vs FBM and switch them when stock position or economics change.

- Submit and follow up on FBA fee and dimension/weight disputes.



Catalog health and troubleshooting

- Monitor and fix suppressed, stranded, inactive, and incomplete listings, and get them live again fast.

- Diagnose and resolve catalog defects: merged or split ASINs, duplicates, wrong category, overwritten content, and variation errors.

- Open, escalate, and follow through on Seller Support and Brand Registry cases until they are actually resolved, not just closed.

- Watch for unauthorized changes, listing hijacks, and content overwrites, and act on them.



Bulk operations and data hygiene

- Run bulk updates via flat files and inventory loader templates without breaking live listings.

- Keep a clean, reconciled source of truth for SKUs, ASINs, and FNSKUs across our systems.

- Audit the catalog on a regular cadence and close gaps before they cost us sessions or the Buy Box.



Brand and content operations

- Maintain Brand Registry, A+ Content modules, and the Brand Store, aligned to our approved copy and imagery.

- Make sure images and detail-page content meet Amazon's requirements.

- Coordinate with our listing SEO, advertising, and creative teams so the catalog supports what they are running.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 2+ years hands-on Amazon Seller Central catalog work for a brand or agency (beyond basic data entry).

- Hands-on with both FBA and FBM: inbound shipment plans, FNSKU and labeling, stranded inventory and reimbursements on the FBA side; shipping templates, handling time, and tracking/on-time metrics on the FBM side.

- Genuinely fluent with flat files, inventory templates, variation families, and bulk uploads. You have rebuilt a broken variation family before.

- Track record recovering suppressed, stranded, and mis-categorized listings.

- Comfortable driving Seller Support and Brand Registry cases to resolution.

- Strong attention to detail, organized, confident in Excel or Google Sheets.

- Clear written English, and you flag problems early instead of sitting on them.



NICE TO HAVE

- Brand Registry, A+ Content, and Brand Store experience.

- Seller Fulfilled Prime or Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF).

- Walmart Seller Center, Shopify, or other marketplace catalog experience.

- Experience coordinating with a 3PL or in-house warehouse (we run ShipStation).

- Wellness, personal-care, or supplement category experience and its documentation requirements.

- Comfort using AI tools to speed up repetitive catalog work.



DETAILS

- Full-time, remote (Philippines).

- Overlap with US business hours, as coordinated with your lead.

- Compensation: Based on Experience.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply via our careers page (includes a short 60-second Loom):







In your application, tell us about one thing you personally fixed: a broken listing or variation family, or a stranded or stuck FBA inventory situation. What was wrong, what you did, and how long it took to get it live or recovered. No ghosting, we reply to everyone.

Design & Product Development

title: Full-Time Wordpress Web Builder
description:
We are looking for a full-time Web Builder / VA to join our team long-term.



This is not a position where we want someone who simply waits for a checklist, completes exactly what is written, and stops.



We are looking for someone who can **think, problem-solve, pay attention, follow instructions, and take ownership of their work.**



### Starting Pay



**$800 USD/month starting salary**



We will begin with a **2-week paid trial for $400**.



If the trial is successful, you will move into the ongoing full-time position at $800/month.



There is absolutely room to grow beyond $800.



The more valuable you become to the company, the more responsibility you can handle, and the more efficiently you can produce high-quality work, the more opportunity there will be for increased compensation.



We would much rather pay more for someone who becomes incredibly valuable than constantly hire new people.



### What You'll Be Working On



Our team builds and manages websites for businesses throughout the United States.



You can expect to work on approximately **4–6 websites per month**, along with other website-related work.



Our average website is approximately **30–40 pages**.



Your work may include:



* Building websites using WordPress + Elementor Pro

* Following approved designs and design systems

* Building desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts

* Working with pre-written and mapped website content

* Making website edits and revisions

* Website QC

* Sourcing and optimizing images

* Setting up forms

* Basic CSS adjustments

* Working with ACF/dynamic content when required

* Basic Rank Math/on-page SEO implementation

* Internal linking

* Blog formatting or occasional blog writing

* Troubleshooting website problems

* Using ChatGPT and Claude to help solve problems and work more efficiently



You do **not** need to be an expert at every single item above on day one.



We care much more about whether you can learn, follow our systems, and become more capable over time.



### What We're Looking For



You should already be comfortable with:



**WordPress**

**Elementor Pro**

**ChatGPT and/or Claude**

**Responsive website design**



More importantly, we're looking for someone who:



* Pays extremely close attention to instructions

* Notices when something doesn't look right

* Asks good questions

* Can work independently

* Works well with a team

* Can troubleshoot before immediately asking someone else to solve the problem

* Uses AI as a tool instead of depending on AI to think for them

* Is willing to learn new systems

* Accepts feedback without becoming defensive

* Takes responsibility for their work

* Communicates when they are stuck

* Thinks outside the box

* Looks for solutions

* Wants to continually become better at their job



**Years of experience are not the d
 factor.**



Someone with 4 years of experience who is hungry, adaptable, and constantly learning is more valuable to us than someone with 10 years of experience who believes they already know everything.



### Schedule



This is a **full-time position**.



We are flexible regarding which days you choose to work.



However, once your work schedule is agreed upon, we expect you to stick to it.



We care about accountability, communication, meeting deadlines, and producing quality work.



### How We Work



You will receive training on our specific processes.



We use SOPs, AI-assisted workflows, project management systems, website templates, design systems, and internal processes to make our work as repeatable as possible.



We do not expect you to magically know our system.



We **do** expect you to learn it.



We also don't want someone who needs step-by-step instructions every time something unexpected happens.



Our ideal team member thinks:



**"What is the outcome we're trying to accomplish, what information do I already have, and what can I try before escalating this?"**



Knowing when to ask a question is just as important as knowing how to solve something yourself.



### Application Instructions



Please answer ALL of the following.



Applications that ignore the instructions may not be considered.



**1. Portfolio**



Send us links to 3 websites you personally worked on.



For each one, briefly explain exactly what YOU were responsible for.



**2. Elementor Experience**



How comfortable are you with Elementor Pro from 1–10?



Tell us what you can confidently do without needing instructions.



**3. AI Experience**



How are you currently using ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools in your work?



Give us one real example.



**4. Problem-Solving Scenario**



Imagine this situation:



You are building a 35-page website in Elementor.



The design and content have already been provided.



You reach one page where the provided content does not fit the approved section design very well. You also notice that the mobile version of the section looks bad.



The project manager is currently unavailable.



**Walk us through exactly what you would do next.**



We are less interested in the "correct answer" than we are in understanding how you think.



Explain:



* What you would check first

* What you would attempt yourself

* Whether you would continue working or stop

* At what point you would ask the team for help

* What information you would include when asking for help



**5. Attention to Detail**



At the very beginning of your application, write:



**"I READ THE ENTIRE POST."**



This is intentionally simple.



### One Last Thing



We are building a team of people who want to become exceptionally good at what they do.



You don't need to know everything.



You do need to care.



If you are someone who learns quickly, takes ownership, enjoys solving problems, and wants an opportunity where becoming more valuable creates more opportunity for you, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Sales Data Analyst
description:
Sales Data Analyst



Reports To: Chief Growth Officer



Position Summary

The Sales Data Analyst is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting sales and operational data to support strategic decision-making across the Growth Division. This role serves as a key business partner to the Chief Growth Officer by transforming complex data into actionable insights that improve sales performance, forecasting accuracy, referral growth strategies, and operational efficiency.



The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and proficient in Microsoft Excel and CRM reporting. They possess the ability to identify trends, build meaningful dashboards, and communicate data in a way that influences business decisions. This individual will also provide administrative and project support to the Chief Growth Officer as organizational priorities evolve. At least 8 hours must be between the hours of 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., US Central Standard Time. Applicant must provide their own technology equipment. 

________________________________________

Essential Responsibilities



Sales Analytics & Reporting

• Analyze sales performance metrics across all markets. 

• Produce recurring daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual sales reports. 

• Track admissions, referrals, conversion rates, and other key performance indicators (KPIs). 

• Monitor performance against sales goals and identify trends requiring leadership attention. 

• Assist with forecasting future sales performance using historical and current data. 

• Prepare executive-level reports and presentations for leadership meetings. 

CRM Management & Data Integrity

• Maintain reporting accuracy within the company's CRM platform. 

• Audit CRM data for completeness and accuracy. 

• Develop dashboards and scorecards for sales leadership. 

• Identify opportunities to improve CRM utilization and reporting efficiency. 

• Support sales leadership with CRM-related reporting and analytics. 

Referral Source & Market Analysis

• Analyze referral source performance and trends. 

• Track referral growth and market share opportunities. 

• Identify referral sources showing increases or declines in volume. 

• Assist in territory analysis and account segmentation. 

• Provide data to support strategic sales planning and market expansion initiatives. 

Forecasting & Strategic Planning

• Develop forecasting models using historical trends and current performance. 

• Assist the Chief Growth Officer with budgeting and growth projections. 

• Identify opportunities for revenue growth through data analysis. 

• Provide recommendations that improve sales effectiveness and resource allocation. 

Executive Support

• Assist the Chief Growth Officer with special projects and strategic initiatives. 

• Prepare reports, presentations, and analytical summaries for executive meetings. 

• Conduct research as requested. 

• Coordinate and complete various administrative and analytical tasks supporting Growth operations. 

• Perform additional duties as assigned. 

________________________________________

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in one of the following preferred:

• Business 

• Finance 

• Data Analytics 

• Statistics 

• Healthcare Administration 

• Information Systems 

• Related field 

Equivalent work experience may be considered.

________________________________________

Experience

Preferred:

• 2–5 years of experience in data analysis, business analytics, sales operations, or healthcare analytics. 

• Experience supporting sales leadership. 

• Experience working with CRM systems. 

• Home Health or Healthcare experience is preferred but not required. 

________________________________________

Required Skills

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills 

o Pivot Tables 

o Power Query 

o Advanced formulas 

o VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP 

o Data visualization 

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills. 

• Ability to interpret large datasets and identify meaningful trends. 

• Excellent attention to detail. 

• Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

• Ability to present complex information in a simple, understandable format. 

• Strong organizational and time-management skills. 

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 

• High degree of confidentiality and professionalism. 

________________________________________

Preferred Technical Skills

Experience with:

• CRM platforms 

• Microsoft Power BI (preferred) 

• Microsoft PowerPoint 

• Microsoft Word 

• Microsoft Teams 

• Microsoft SharePoint 

• SQL knowledge (preferred but not required) 

________________________________________

Core Competencies

• Analytical Thinking 

• Business Acumen 

• Strategic Planning 

• Problem Solving 

• Initiative 

• Collaboration 

• Communication 

• Adaptability 

• Organization 

• Data Accuracy 

• Confidentiality 

________________________________________

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:

• Accuracy and timeliness of reporting 

• Improvement in CRM data quality 

• Quality of forecasting and strategic recommendations 

• Ability to identify actionable sales opportunities through data 

• Executive satisfaction with reporting and analytical support 

• Efficiency in completing projects for the Chief Growth Officer 

• Contribution to achieving company growth objectives 

________________________________________

Why Join Paradigm Home Health?

At Paradigm Home Health, we believe data drives better decisions—and better decisions improve patient care. As our Sales Data Analyst, you'll play a critical role in shaping growth strategy by providing meaningful insights that help our leadership team make informed decisions. You'll work directly with the Chief Growth Officer, gain exposure to executive-level strategy, and have the opportunity to influence the future of one of Texas' fastest-growing clinician-owned home health organizations.

title: Outbound Caller & Lead Generation Specialist
description:
READ THIS FIRST: The shift is 8:00 PM to 3:00 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday. That is 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM in Florida. This is a permanent night schedule. If that will not work for you long term, please do not apply. We would rather you keep your time.



ABOUT US



We are NH Repairs, a commercial and municipal fleet maintenance shop in Pompano Beach, Florida. We service and repair the vehicles that local businesses and city governments run on: the work trucks of contractors, plumbers, electricians and landscapers, plus heavy-duty tractors and trailers. We are small, we are growing, and we have big plans.



We run lean. Every person here owns their work, and you will be working directly with the owner.



We are hiring one person to make our outbound calls and generate our leads. That is the whole job, and right now it is the most important open seat in the company.



This is a phone-first role. You will spend most of your shift on the phone: calling back the people who contacted us, calling the customers who were quoted work and never came back, and calling businesses in our target lists. Text and
 back you up, they do not replace the call.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



Follow-up calling, about 45% of your time. This is the heart of the job. Right now leads slip through the cracks. You will stop that.



Call back every missed call the same day, and text as a backup when nobody picks up

Call every new inquiry from our ads within 5 minutes, while they are still d
 who to call

Work the deferred repair list: vehicles we already inspected, work we already quoted, jobs that were never scheduled

Follow up on open estimates until you get a yes or a no

Call back customers we have not seen in 6 months or more

Call after every completed repair to check in and ask for a review

Log every inbound call in our shared attribution tracker so we know which ads are producing real work and which ones are wasting money



Lead generation, about 45% of your time. Half of your leads are already sitting in our system. The other half are local fleets we have not called yet. You will work both.



Mine System for work that is already due: customers with preventive maintenance coming up, DOT inspections expiring, and units with open or deferred repairs. Call them and get the truck scheduled.

Go through our existing customer list unit by unit and find out what each fleet has coming up

Work our target lists of local businesses and fleets. We already have the lists. What we lack is the discipline to work them, and you will bring that.

Find the right person at each company, the owner, the fleet manager, or whoever signs off on repairs, and start a real conversation

Run supporting
 and SMS campaigns to the same lists

Keep calling until you get a yes or a no, and log every touch and every outcome



Marketing support, about 10%.



Help put together a newsletter twice a month, using AI tools heavily. We expect you to move fast with them.

Help with website content and messaging

Keep our message consistent across calls,
, text and social

Report on what is working and what is not



And whatever else the business needs. We are small and titles are loose here. If you see something broken and fix it, that gets noticed.



SYSTEMS YOU WILL LIVE IN



Fullbay, our shop management system. Every repair order, estimate, unit and customer history lives here, and it is where most of your leads will come from. You will learn it in your first two weeks. It is straightforward.

Our phone and SMS platform, currently being upgraded. You will help us make it work.

CRM,
 marketing tools, Google Sheets, and AI writing tools



You need to be genuinely comfortable with software. Not an engineer, but the kind of person who opens a new tool and figures it out without a manual, and who spots a better way to do something and says so.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



*Clear, confident spoken English. This is the most important requirement. You will be on the phone with American business owners, shop managers and municipal fleet staff every day, under our name. Neutral accent, easy to understand, comfortable holding a conversation that is not on a script.

*Strong written English. Your texts and
s go straight to customers. Clear and natural, not stiff and not robotic.

*Real outbound experience. You have called strangers and existing customers for a living and you are not nervous about it.

*Background we especially want: dealership service BDC, appointment setting, outbound sales or SDR work on a US account, service scheduling, customer retention or reactivation, US collections, or contact center work with an outbound component.

*Tech savvy. Comfortable in new software, spreadsheets, CRMs and AI tools.

*Relentless follow-up. Most of this job is the third and fourth call.

*Automotive, truck or fleet experience is a plus, not a requirement. We will teach you the vehicles.

Reliable internet with a backup connection, backup power, a quiet workspace, and a good headset. On a night shift there is nobody to cover for you.



NOT A FIT IF



You cannot commit to a permanent night schedule

You are looking for general admin or virtual assistant work

You are uncomfortable on the phone, or you only want to do chat and

You measure your work in calls made rather than results

You want a narrow job description that never changes



HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED



On one thing: vehicles that come through our bay doors because you got them there. Not calls made, not messages sent, not appointments booked. Vehicles that arrive and get worked on. We will show you the number every week, and we pay you on it.



COMPENSATION



USD $4.50 to $5.50 per hour depending on experience. Performance commissions for vehicles that arrive because of your outreach begin after a 90-day trial period. Paid twice a month in USD via Wise, PayPal, or direct deposit.



This is a long-term role, not a project. The right person grows with the shop, and we treat long-term contributors well.



TO APPLY, INCLUDE



1.) A 2-minute voice or video recording in English. Tell us about a customer or prospect you got to say yes after they had already said no. What did you actually do?

2.) A short note on your last phone-heavy role and what number you were measured on. Give us the real figure.

3.) A writing sample. Write the actual text message you would send to a customer whose truck was inspected six weeks ago, who was quoted $1,800 in brake and suspension work, and who never scheduled it. Keep it under 60 words.

4.) Written confirmation that you can work 8:00 PM to 3:00 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday, long term.

5.) A description of your internet setup and your backup plan for power and connection.

6.) The word AIRBRAKE somewhere in your application.



Applications without the voice recording and the writing sample will not be reviewed.

description:
We are hiring a **per-project WordPress + Elementor website builder** to work with our website production team.



This position is ideal for someone who wants consistent project work, clear systems, and the ability to earn more as they prove they can handle projects independently.



We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to drag Elementor widgets onto a page.



We want someone who **thinks.**



You should be able to follow instructions, pay attention to details, troubleshoot problems, communicate well, and use tools like ChatGPT and Claude intelligently.



### What We Provide



Our production process is highly systemized.



For standard website builds, **the website content will already be provided and mapped into the build.**



You are not being paid these project rates to research and write an entire website from scratch.



Your primary responsibility is taking the assets, content, instructions, and systems we provide and turning them into a polished finished website.



### What You'll Do



Projects may include:



* WordPress website builds

* Elementor Pro

* Responsive desktop/tablet/mobile implementation

* Following approved designs or templates

* Implementing mapped website content

* Forms

* Images and image optimization

* Internal linking

* Basic on-page SEO implementation

* Rank Math

* ACF/dynamic content when required

* CSS adjustments

* Website QC

* Revisions

* Troubleshooting issues

* Following our build SOPs and documentation requirements



We will train you on our specific production system.



### Compensation



This is a **per-project position**, not a monthly salary.



#### Probation Period



During your initial probation/training period:



**$90 per completed standard website**



There is no bonus structure during probation.



The purpose of this period is to learn our process, understand our expectations, and demonstrate that you can consistently complete projects correctly.



Once you have proven yourself, you can advance into our normal production tiers.



#### Tier 1 — Production Builder



Standard 10-page website:



**$70 base**



Plus:



* $10 First-Pass QC Bonus

* $5 On-Time Completion Bonus

* $5 Clean Handoff / Documentation Bonus



**Up to $90 per standard 10-page website**



#### Additional Pages



Pages beyond the standard project are compensated based on complexity:



**Basic / cloned page:** $3 per page



**Enhanced page:** $4 per page



Advanced custom pages, functionality, or unusual project requirements are priced separately before work begins.



#### Tier 2 — Certified Builder



**$100 per standard 10-page website**



Tier 2 is earned through performance.



Typically, we want to see at least 5 successful builds demonstrating:



* Strong first-pass QC

* Reliable on-time delivery

* Good communication

* No recurring quality issues

* Understanding of our SOPs

* Ability to troubleshoot independently



#### Tier 3 — Advanced Builder



Typically:



**$125–$175+ per project**



These builders can handle more complex projects, troubleshoot independently, require less management, and consistently produce high-quality work.



Your earning potential increases as your value and capabilities increase.



### Who We're Looking For



Experience matters, but **how you work matters more.**



We would rather hire someone with 4 years of experience who is adaptable, hungry, and pays attention than someone with 10 years of experience who is stuck in their ways.



You should:



* Have solid Elementor Pro experience

* Understand WordPress

* Be comfortable using ChatGPT and/or Claude

* Follow instructions carefully

* Ask questions when something is genuinely unclear

* Be capable of working independently

* Communicate well with a team

* Notice mistakes before QC notices them

* Be willing to learn our processes

* Accept constructive feedback

* Take deadlines seriously

* Think critically

* Troubleshoot problems

* Look for solutions instead of immediately saying something cannot be done



We don't expect you to know our internal AI systems before joining.



If you already understand how to effectively use ChatGPT or Claude, we can teach you our specific workflows.



### The Mentality We're Looking For



When you encounter a problem, we don't want your first response to be:



**"What do I do?"**



We want you to first think:



**"What is supposed to happen here? What information do I have? What can I test? Can I solve this safely myself? If I can't, what information does the team need from me to help solve it?"**



There is nothing wrong with asking questions.



In fact, asking good questions is extremely important.



But there is a major difference between asking a thoughtful question after investigating a problem and requiring someone to think through every problem for you.



### How to Apply



Please complete everything below.



**Start your application with:**



**"I READ THE ENTIRE POST."**



Then answer:



**1. Portfolio**



Send 3 Elementor websites you personally worked on.



Tell us specifically what YOU did on each website.



**2. Experience**



How long have you been working with WordPress and Elementor?



What parts of a website build can you confidently complete independently?



**3. AI**



How do you currently use ChatGPT or Claude while building websites?



Give us a real example.



**4. Problem-Solving Scenario**



Imagine you are assigned a website.



The content has already been written and mapped.



You are halfway through the build and notice three things:



1. One section does not fit the content very well.

2. The mobile version looks significantly worse than the desktop version.

3. A form is not submitting properly.



The project manager will not be available for the next two hours.



**Explain exactly what you would do.**



Walk us through your thought process in order.



Tell us:



* What you investigate

* What you try yourself

* What you would change without approval

* What you would NOT change without approval

* What work you would continue completing

* When you would escalate something

* What you would send the project manager when asking for help



There isn't one perfect answer.



We want to see how you think.



### Growth



We want builders who become more valuable over time.



Someone who starts by following our SOPs but eventually becomes capable of independently troubleshooting difficult builds is worth considerably more to us.



If you're competent, reliable, efficient, willing to learn, and interested in getting better instead of simply getting projects done, this could become a very strong long-term opportunity.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
We're looking for a reliable, organized, and customer-focused Customer Support Specialist to join our team. This role is a great fit for someone who communicates well, enjoys helping customers, can stay organized while handling multiple tickets, and is comfortable working independently in a remote environment.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



- Take support calls and provide chat support.

- Manage ticket intake and make sure tickets are properly assigned to the appropriate remote or field technician.

- Monitor ticket progress and follow up to keep requests moving.

- Maintain complete and accurate ticket documentation.

- Handle client correspondence in a professional and timely manner. 

- Coordinate with different departments to move tickets forward, including:

    - Sales: Quotes, site walks, proposals

    - Admin: Scheduling and equipment reservations

    - Warehouse: Inventory checks, RMAs, and new orders

    - Project Team: Tickets related to ongoing or recently completed projects

    - Customer Relations: Customer questions, concerns, and follow-ups

- Keep customers updated throughout the support process.

- Identify when an issue needs to be escalated to MGT.

- Help ensure tickets are properly followed through to completion.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



- Customer service or customer support experience

- Call center experience is a PLUS, but NOT required

- Experience working remotely or as a Virtual Assistant is a PLUS

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills

- Highly organized and detail-oriented

- Comfortable handling multiple tasks/tickets at the same time

- Good problem-solving and follow-up skills

- Comfortable working independently while also collaborating with a team

- ZOHO knowledge is a PLUS, but is not required

- Reliable, dependable, and able to work on a consistent schedule



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



Because this is a work-from-home position, you must have:



- Computer/Laptop: Intel i5/Ryzen 5 or better, 16GB RAM, SSD, capable of handling multiple tabs and applications

- Internet: PRIMARY connection of at least 50 Mbps. and BACKUP INTERNET (Mobile Hotspot/Secondary ISP) with at least 10 Mbps.

- Backup Power: UPS, power station, or equivalent

- Headset: Clear microphone/headset suitable for customer calls and meetings.

- Workspace: Quiet, reliable workspace suitable for calls and remote work.

- Work Tracking: We use Workfolio to track work time and monitor work-related app and internet usage while clocked in. Applicants must be comfortable with this requirement.



TO PROCEED: Please send us a message with your updated resume and a short video recording introducing yourself.



In your video, please tell us:



1. A little about yourself and your previous CS experience.

2. How would you handle a customer who is frustrated because their issue has not been resolved yet?

3. How do you stay organized when you have several customers or tickets that need your attention at the same time?

4. Why do you think you would be a good fit for this role? 



Please keep the video around 2-3 minutes and just talk naturally. No need for scripted or AI-generated responses. We want to get a genuine feel for how you communicate, your personality, and how you would naturally handle situations related to the role.



Thank you!

What You'll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will include:



* Responding to customer
s and support tickets

* Good problem-solving skills
