title: Executive Virtual Assistant — CRO Support (Financial Services)
description:
Role:



The Executive Virtual Assistant is the operational backbone of a fast-growing financial advisory firm. You'll work directly with the Chief Revenue Officer to eliminate bottlenecks, execute processes, and keep systems running so leadership can focus on strategy instead of admin.



This isn't a "check your
 and schedule meetings" VA role. You'll be inside HubSpot pulling reports and executing outreach, posting social media replies through Sprout Social, coordinating contractors, running SMS broadcasts, and keeping our project management system clean and current. You'll follow SOPs we've already built, but you'll also be expected to flag when something is broken and suggest a better way.



Here's what you'll actually do:



- Post AI-generated social media replies across
, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X through Sprout Social — reviewing each for quality before publishing

- Manage SMS broadcast campaigns — pulling lists from HubSpot, scheduling sends, and monitoring delivery

- Pull and compile reports from HubSpot — surfacing key metrics, pipeline snapshots, and deal activity summaries so leadership doesn't have to dig for information

- Keep our project management system (Asana) organized — chasing tea
mbers for status updates, archiving dead projects, and ensuring dashboards reflect reality

- Handle webinar logistics — registration list management, reminder sequences, post-event follow-up segmentation, and replay distribution

- Coordinate marketing contractors — collecting deliverables, tracking deadlines, routing approvals, and following up so nothing falls through the cracks



To win in this role, you need to be detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working across multiple platforms simultaneously. You should be someone who takes ownership of processes — not someone who waits to be told what to do next.



## Why This Role Matters (for You):



If you want to learn how a high-growth US financial services company actually operates — from sales pipelines to marketing automation to client experience — this role gives you a front-row seat.



You'll work directly with leadership, not through layers of middle management. You'll touch every part of the business: sales ops, marketing, content, client experience, and technology. That breadth of exposure is rare and will make you significantly more valuable in any future role.



We invest in training. We have documented SOPs, video walkthroughs, and AI tools that do the heavy thinking — your job is reliable execution and continuous improvement. We don't micromanage, but we do expect ownership.



If you thrive in structured environments where the playbook exists and you just need to run it well — you'll love this. If you need someone standing over your shoulder to stay productive, this isn't the right fit.



## Responsibilities



- Execute social media engagement workflows daily — reviewing AI-generated replies for tone and accuracy, then publishing through Sprout Social across all platforms

- Manage and send SMS marketing broadcasts using our SMS platform, including list preparation and scheduling

- Own the YouTube production coordination workflow — tracking recurring tasks, managing approvals, and ensuring content ships on schedule

- Compile weekly CRM reports — pulling pipeline snapshots, deal velocity metrics, and activity summaries from HubSpot so leadership has what they need without digging for it

- Maintain project management hygiene in Asana — collecting status updates, archiving completed or abandoned projects, and keeping dashboards accurate

- Coordinate webinar operations end-to-end — from registration list pulls through post-event follow-up sequences

- Serve as the communication layer between leadership and marketing contractors — tracking deliverables, deadlines, and approvals

- Document and improve processes — when you find a better way to do something, write it down so it scales



## Results



- Social media replies posted within 24 hours of comment, with zero off-brand or inaccurate responses published

- Weekly CRM reports delivered on time — leadership has pipeline and activity visibility without asking for it

- Asana dashboards reflect actual project status — every active project has a current status update

- Webinar logistics executed without missed steps — registrations captured, reminders sent, follow-ups segmented

- Contractor deliverables tracked and delivered on time — nothing falls through the cracks between request and completion



## Requirements



- 3+ years of experience as a Virtual Assistant, Executive Assistant, or Operations Coordinator supporting US-based businesses

- Strong working knowledge of HubSpot CRM (deal management, contact properties, list building, task management)

- Experience with social media management tools (Sprout Social preferred, but Hootsuite, Buffer, or similar accepted)

- Proficiency in project management tools (Asana, Monday, ClickUp, or similar)

- Excellent written English — you'll be reviewing client-facing social media content in a regulated industry

- Highly organized with strong attention to detail — financial services has zero tolerance for sloppy mistakes

- Self-motivated and proactive — you flag problems before they become emergencies

- Comfortable learning new tools quickly — we use HubSpot, Sprout Social, Asana, Slack, SalesMessage, Google Workspace, and several other platforms

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace for occasional video calls



## Nice to Have (Not Required)



- Experience in financial services, wealth management, or insurance industries

- Familiarity with SMS marketing platforms (SalesMessage, ClickSend, or similar)

- Experience with webinar platforms (EverWebinar, Zoom Webinars, or similar)

- Basic understanding of sales pipelines and CRM workflows

- Experience coordinating with contractors or freelancers



## Schedule & Compensation



- **Hours:** Full-time (40 hours/week)

- **Schedule:** Flexible, with 3-4 hours of overlap required during US Mountain Time business hours (9 AM – 5 PM MT) for real-time communication and approvals

- **Rate:** $7–$10/hour USD, depending on experience

- **Type:** Long-term, ongoing position — this is not a project-based role



## About Us



Q3 Advisors is a flat-fee fiduciary financial advisory firm specializing in Roth conversion strategies. We've grown from $1.9M to $15M+ in revenue in three years with a lean, high-performance team. We move fast, we build systems, and we take care of our people.



You'll be joining a team that includes sales reps, financial planners, marketing specialists, and operations staff — all working together to help retirees keep more of their money. The work matters, the team is sharp, and the company is growing.

Key Tools: CapCut / VN / Premiere, Canva, Meta Business Suite, IG Edits App, Go High Level (our scheduling tool), Google Workspace, Slack, Asana, ChatGPT



Your Role

Responsibilities include:

- Create On-Brand Graphics - Design quote cards, carousel slides, tweet-style posts, etc. in Canva.

- Schedule & Publish - Queue 4 posts/day across IG, FB, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts &
; double-check each post goes live.

- Stories & Micro-Content - Pull daily Stories, add stickers/polls/CTAs to keep followers engaged.

- Weekly Reporting - Quick one-pager: posts published, reach, engagement %, lead DMs, top 3 wins, next-week tweaks.

- Trend Spotting & Experiments - Suggest hashtags, audio, or formats to test; track results.



Who You Are

We want someone who is:

- Detail-Oriented & Reliable – a missed post = missed lead.

- Creative Eye – you know what hooks viewers in the first 3 seconds.

- Strong English Copy – captions sound like Alexis: authoritative yet friendly.

- Trainable & Coachable – open to feedback in a fast-moving environment.

- Goal-Driven – you hit daily/weekly targets without constant reminders.

- Trustworthy & Ethical – ZERO tolerance for time-cheating or shady practices.

- Flexible Schedule – comfortable with PH night / early-AM work blocks.

- Critical Thinker – can adapt scripts, fix a failed post, or troubleshoot on the fly.



Key Results (Your KPIs)

- Consistency – 28 posts/week live on schedule.

- Engagement Growth – comments, shares, saves rising month-over-month.

- Reach Growth – impressions & followers trending up weekly.

- Lead Volume – trackable inquiry DMs / link clicks from posts.



What We Offer

- Mission-Driven Culture – help women regain health & confidence.

- Growth Path – bigger creative projects & bonuses for smashing KPIs.

- Supportive Team – clear SOPs, quick feedback, open communication.



Requirements

- 3+ years as a Social Media / Content VA (or similar).

- Portfolio showing BOTH short-form video edits and Canva graphics.

- Solid Canva + short-form video software proficiency.

- Stable 50 Mbps internet & backup power.



How to Apply

If you’re ready to empower individuals through fitness and join a dynamic, fast-paced team, we’d love to hear from you. Please click this link and apply:

title: Apparel Illustrator / Graphic Designer – Japanese-Inspired Clothing Brand
description:
We are looking for a talented Illustrator / Graphic Designer to create original artwork for an established e-commerce clothing brand.



This is NOT a position for creating ads, social media graphics, website banners, or marketing materials.



Your job will be focused on one thing: creating original artwork and designs that will be printed on clothing.



What We're Looking For



We want someone who is genuinely talented at illustration and design.



Our brand is heavily inspired by Japanese culture and aesthetics, but our designs can vary significantly in style. You should be comfortable adapting to different visual directions rather than being limited to one specific illustration style.



We care much more about the quality of your work and portfolio than how many years of experience you have.



Experience creating artwork for apparel, streetwear, or clothing brands is preferred, but not required.



Your Responsibilities



Your main responsibility will be creating original artwork for our clothing designs.



We will provide concepts, references, ideas, and creative direction for many designs. For some projects, you may also be given more freedom to interpret an idea in your own way.



You should be able to:



* Create original illustrations from scratch

* Work from references and creative direction

* Adapt to different illustration and graphic styles

* Combine illustration, composition, and typography when a design requires it

* Make revisions based on feedback

* Deliver at least 4–5+ quality designs per week

* Prepare artwork suitable for printing on apparel



Knowledge of designing for DTG printing and preparing print-ready artwork is a plus.



What We Care About



We're not looking for someone who can simply use graphic design software.



We're looking for someone who has a strong artistic eye and actual illustration/design ability.



You should understand composition, typography, color, balance, and what makes artwork visually appealing on a T-shirt or other piece of clothing.



Most importantly, you should be able to create original artwork, not simply combine templates or stock graphics. At the very beginning of your application, write the word SAKURA so we know you read the entire job post.



AI tools may be used as part of your creative process when appropriate, but you must have the ability to create and modify artwork yourself. We are not looking for someone who simply generates AI images and submits them as finished designs.



Work Arrangement



We are open to both full-time and part-time applicants.



You can work on your own schedule. We care primarily about communication, reliability, meeting deadlines, and the quality of the designs you deliver. 



There is also opportunity for performance-based bonuses and pay increases for consistently strong work.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid design test before being hired.



How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following questions in your application:



1. Tell us about your experience as an illustrator or graphic designer.



2. Have you created designs for clothing, apparel, or streetwear brands before? If yes, please explain what you worked on.



3. What software do you use to create your illustrations and designs?



4. Which illustration/design styles are you strongest at?



5. Are you comfortable creating Japanese-inspired artwork in different styles?



6. Are you able to create original illustrations from scratch?



7. Do you have experience preparing artwork for DTG printing or other apparel printing methods?



8. Do you use AI tools as part of your design process? If yes, explain exactly how you use them.



9. How many high-quality apparel designs do you believe you can realistically complete per week?



10. Are you currently working for another company or client? If yes, approximately how many hours per week?



11. Are you looking for full-time or part-time work?



12. Please provide a link to your portfolio.



Your portfolio is the most important part of your application.



Please send examples that demonstrate your actual illustration and artwork abilities. We are especially interested in apparel graphics, illustrations, streetwear designs, Japanese-inspired artwork, or similar work.



If your portfolio mostly consists of advertisements, social media posts, website banners, Canva designs, or other marketing graphics, this position is probably not the right fit.



Applications without a portfolio or without answers to the questions above will not be considered.



We're looking for someone we can work with long-term who can consistently create strong, original artwork for our brand.

title: PPC (Google Ads) Lead Generation Specialist
description:
Lightsail Solutions is a venture-backed, US-based freight forwarding startup making global freight and procurement simpler, more transparent and more efficient. As an early-stage company, our priorities and processes evolve quickly. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of our paid search acquisition channel, continuously improve campaign performance, and independently identify opportunities to generate more qualified leads at a lower cost.



We are looking for a PPC / Google Ads Specialist to own and grow Lightsail Solutions' paid search campaigns. This role is primarily focused on Google Ads and performance marketing. You will be responsible for the full acquisition funnel, from keyword research and campaign creation to ad optimisation, conversion tracking and landing page development.



You should be comfortable working independently with campaign data, identifying areas for improvement and testing new approaches to increase qualified leads while reducing cost per acquisition. This is not simply an ads-monitoring role. We are looking for someone who can actively identify new opportunities, create new campaigns and landing pages, improve targeting and continuously optimise the entire paid search funnel.



Key Responsibilities

* Own the day-to-day management and optimisation of Google Ads campaigns

* Create and launch new Search campaigns, ad groups and advertisements

* Conduct keyword research to identify high-intent and commercially valuable search terms

* Analyse search term reports and continuously expand positive and negative keyword lists

* Optimise bidding strategies, budgets, targeting and campaign structure to improve performance

* Write and test ad headlines, descriptions and calls-to-action

* Monitor campaign metrics including CPC, CTR, conversion rate, CPA and lead quality

* Identify underperforming campaigns, keywords and advertisements and implement improvements

* Develop and test new landing pages tailored to specific keywords, customer segments and campaigns

* Improve landing page conversion rates through changes to copy, structure, calls-to-action and user experience

* Conduct A/B tests across advertisements, landing pages and campaign strategies

* Set up and maintain accurate conversion tracking through Google Ads, Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager

* Analyse lead quality and downstream conversion data to optimise campaigns for actual business results rather than simply clicks or form submissions

* Research competitors, their advertisements, keywords and positioning to identify new acquisition opportunities

* Build campaigns targeting new customer segments, industries and geographic markets

* Produce regular reports explaining campaign performance, key findings and recommended actions

* Independently identify and test new approaches to improve paid acquisition performance



Requirements

* Hands-on experience managing Google Ads Search campaigns

* Strong understanding of PPC fundamentals, including keyword match types, bidding strategies, Quality Score, negative keywords and campaign structure

* Demonstrated experience conducting keyword research and identifying high-intent commercial keywords

* Strong understanding of campaign metrics including CPC, CTR, conversion rate, CPA and ROAS

* Experience setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking

* Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager

* Experience creating or modifying landing pages for paid advertising campaigns

* Strong understanding of conversion rate optimisation and landing page best practices

* Comfortable analysing campaign data and making decisions based on performance

* Able to write clear and persuasive B2B advertising and landing page copy

* Proactive and resourceful, with the ability to independently identify problems and opportunities

* Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing budgets, keywords and conversion tracking

* Able to manage multiple campaigns and experiments simultaneously

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment where priorities may change quickly

* Strong written English

* Available to start immediately or within a short notice period is an advantage



Nice to Have

* Previous experience running Google Ads for B2B services

* Experience advertising logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, procurement, SaaS or other high-value B2B services

* Experience with lead-generation campaigns where conversions happen through forms, phone calls or sales conversations rather than direct e-commerce purchases

* Experience with Google Ads Editor

* Experience with landing page builders such as Webflow, WordPress, Unbounce, Framer or similar platforms

* Basic HTML/CSS knowledge

* Experience with tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, SpyFu or similar keyword and competitor research platforms

* Experience connecting advertising data with CRM systems such as HubSpot or Pipedrive

* Experience with Microsoft Ads is an advantage



Compensation

Up to US$1,500 per month, depending on relevant experience and technical capabilities.



Performance-based incentives may also be payable based on qualified leads generated and improvements in campaign performance.

title: Weekend IT Support Specialist — Retail Systems
description:
Weekend IT Support Specialist — Retail Systems

Part-time | Remote (Philippines) | US$5 per hour | Weekends only



A multi-site Australian fashion retailer is looking for a dependable, service-minded Weekend IT Support Specialist to provide first-line remote support across ~55 stores.



You'll help store teams resolve common technology issues quickly, minimise disruption to trade, and make sure anything that can't be solved remotely is clearly documented and escalated. Practical troubleshooting matters — and so does patience, empathy and clear communication. Many store users have varied technical confidence, so explaining the next step simply is just as important as finding the fix.



The Opportunity

Pay: US$5 per hour (fixed advertised rate).

Arrangement: Part-time, ongoing weekend contractor engagement.

Schedule: Saturday and Sunday, 9:00am–8:00pm AEST (11 hours each day; about 22 hours per weekend).

Network: ~55 retail stores; typically ~15–20 tickets per weekend.

Core tools: NinjaOne remote support and Cegid POS.

Start: As soon as practical. Please include your earliest start date and any notice period.



What you'll be responsible for

- Provide first-line weekend IT support throughout the full Sat–Sun coverage window.

- Receive, triage and manage ~15–20 support tickets across the retail network each weekend.

- Troubleshoot remotely using NinjaOne, guiding store team members through practical, step-by-step fixes.

- Support store trading systems and equipment, including Cegid POS, Microsoft Surface Pro devices, printers, EFTPOS terminals, cash drawers, scanners, in-store music devices and media displayed on store televisions.

- Prioritise i
 by store and customer impact — especially issues that prevent or disrupt trade.

- Resolve known issues using approved training, documented procedures and workarounds.

- Escalate complex, unfamiliar or unresolved i
 to the client IT team with accurate notes, troubleshooting completed and relevant evidence.

- Maintain clear ticket records (issue details, actions, outcomes, outstanding items, follow-up).

- Provide a concise weekend handover for unresolved or recurring issues.

- Handle system access and store information securely, following approved policies.



Support approach

- Communicate calmly and respectfully, especially when a store team member is under pressure.

- Use plain English, avoid unnecessary jargon, and check the user understands each step.

- Take ownership through to resolution, escalation or documented handover.

- Keep store teams informed so they know what is happening and what to expect next.



What you'll bring (must-haves)

- Fluent English (spoken and written) — required. You must be confident supporting Australian store teams by phone and through ticket channels with clear, natural English.

- At least two years' experience in service desk, help desk or technical support — ideally multi-site retail, hospitality or customer-facing.

- Strong first-line troubleshooting across Windows/Microsoft environments, endpoint connectivity and common retail peripherals.

- Experience supporting POS systems and payment/store hardware; Cegid advantageous but not essential.

- Patient, practical, customer-focused communication.

- Sound judgement — know what to fix now vs escalate.

- Strong reliability across the full Saturday and Sunday 9:00am–8:00pm AEST window.

- Secure home working setup, reliable internet, and a dependable backup plan for connectivity/power interruption.

- Experience with remote monitoring/support tools; NinjaOne advantageous (training provided).



Training & success

You'll be trained on common weekend issues, approved troubleshooting steps, systems and escalation pathways. Success looks like prompt, calm support for stores; accurate first-line fixes with minimal trade disruption; clear tickets; timely escalations; clean Monday handovers; and growing self-sufficiency as the knowledge base develops.



How to apply

Apply with your CV and brief answers to these questions:

1) Confirm you have fluent spoken and written English suitable for Australian retail teams (Yes/No). How do you typically support users by phone?

2) How many years of service desk / help desk / technical support experience do you have, and in what environments?

3) Which remote support / RMM tools have you used (e.g. NinjaOne, AnyDesk, TeamViewer, similar)?

4) Describe a POS or retail-store IT issue you personally fixed end-to-end (what was broken, what you did, outcome).

5) Can you work every Saturday and Sunday 9:00am–8:00pm AEST at US$5 per hour? Confirm secure home setup + backup connectivity. Earliest start date?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a brief screen and meet the team. Applications are being reviewed now.

title: Logistics – Cores Agent
description:
Position Summary



The Logistics – Cores Agent is responsible for managing the end-to-end lifecycle of "core" parts and units — defective, used, or returnable components exchanged as part of BGSN's field service, warranty, and repair operations. This role ensures cores are accurately tracked, promptly returned to vendors or repair depots, and reconciled against contractual timelines to avoid billing penalties, lost credits, or inventory shrinkage. The agent works closely with field technicians, warehouse staff, vendors, and account management teams to keep the core return pipeline moving efficiently.



Key Responsibilities



-Track and manage the intake, staging, and outbound shipment of core parts returned from field technicians and service sites

-Maintain accurate core inventory records in the warehouse management system, including serial/part numbers, condition codes, and status

-Coordinate core return shipments with carriers and third-party logistics (3PL) partners, ensuring compliance with vendor and client return windows (e.g., 30/60/90-day cycles)

-Monitor aging core reports and proactively follow up on overdue or missing returns to prevent unbilled core charges or contractual penalties

-Reconcile core credits and charges against purchase orders, invoices, and client billing statements

-Investigate and resolve discrepancies related to missing, damaged, or misidentified cores

-Communicate with field technicians and dispatch teams to confirm proper core packaging, labeling, and documentation prior to shipment

-Generate and distribute regular status reports on core inventory, aging, and return compliance to internal stakeholders and client account managers

-Support audits of core inventory accuracy through cycle counts and physical reconciliation

-Escalate unresolved core disputes or process gaps to the Logistics Supervisor/Manager

-Maintain compliance with client-specific core handling requirements (e.g., OEM warranty programs, RMA procedures)



Required Qualifications



-High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's degree in logistics, supply chain, or related field preferred

-1–3 years of experience in logistics, warehouse operations, reverse logistics, or returns/RMA management

-Working knowledge of inventory management or ERP/WMS systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, or similar)

-Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage high transaction volumes

-Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP) for tracking and reporting

-Clear written and verbal communication skills for coordinating across internal teams, vendors, and clients

-Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet strict return deadlines



Preferred Qualifications



-Experience with reverse logistics in field service, telecom, retail technology, or appliance repair industries

-Familiarity with OEM warranty/core return programs and RMA workflows

-Experience supporting multi-site or multi-country logistics operations



Key Competencies



-Detail-oriented and process-driven

-Strong problem-solving and follow-through

-Comfortable working under deadline pressure with financial accountability tied to timely returns

-Collaborative, cross-functional communicator

title: Airbnb / Short-Term Rental Operations VA — 45+ Unit Portfolio (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT US



We operate a portfolio of 45+ short-term rental properties across the United States, generating seven-figure annual revenue.



Our operation is fully remote. We primarily host corporate travelers and families—we do not operate party houses.



This is a real hospitality operations role, not a generic administrative VA position. We are building a disciplined, process-driven team and want people who take ownership, exercise sound judgment, solve problems, and are looking for long-term stability.



THE ROLE



We are hiring three full-time Guest Experience VAs across two core shifts:



Morning Shift: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time

Evening Shift: 5:00 PM–1:00 AM Eastern Time



When applying, indicate whether you prefer the Morning Shift, Evening Shift, or are Flexible and can reliably work either shift.



Schedule: Six days per week, with one agreed day off

Compensation: $7–$9 USD per hour, depending on experience

Location: Fully remote

Paid Trial: Two weeks

Bonuses: Monthly performance bonuses based on response times, guest review scores, reliability, and low escalation rates

13th Month Pay: Yes

Commitment: Long-term, ideally 12+ months



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



One of these positions may develop into an Elite VA / Operations Management role for an exceptional performer.



Elite VA / Operations Management compensation ranges from $11–$15 USD per hour, depending on experience, workload, responsibilities, and demonstrated performance.



Advancement will be based on leadership, operational judgment, reliability, ownership, and the ability to improve the team’s performance—not simply time in the role.



WHAT YOU’LL DO EVERY SHIFT



- Respond to guest messages within 10 minutes with warm, professional, and solution-oriented communication

- Coordinate cleaners and maintenance vendors through Slack, including turnovers, schedules, supply issues, access problems, and follow-ups

- Manage early check-ins, late check-outs, booking extensions, and same-day booking requests

- File and follow up on Airbnb AirCover and Resolution Center claims

- Monitor Schlage smart locks and Blink cameras, troubleshoot access issues, and flag potential rule violations

- Follow up proactively when cleaners or vendors miss deadlines or fail to respond

- Complete detailed shift handoff notes before logging off—every shift, without exception

- Read the complete guest conversation and reservation notes before responding

- Follow SOPs in Notion and flag anything that is missing, outdated, or unclear

- Make sound decisions in routine situations without waiting for manager approval

- Escalate serious issues promptly with complete and organized information



CORE SOFTWARE REQUIREMENTS



You must have recent, direct, hands-on experience with all three of the following:



- Hospitable

- Notion

- Slack



We will train you on our properties, policies, team structure, and company-specific SOPs. However, this role is not intended for someone who needs to learn our core software from the beginning.



Experience with SuiteOp is a strong bonus.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



- At least two years of direct Airbnb, STR, or property-management VA experience

- Recent hands-on experience with Hospitable, Notion, and Slack

- Experience personally supporting multiple active short-term rental units

- Strong written English at a C1 level or higher

- Professional, natural, and guest-ready communication

- Calm decision-making during urgent and after-hours situations

- Ability to follow documented procedures while still exercising common sense

- Reliable internet of at least 50 Mbps

- Reliable computer and quiet workspace

- Availability for a stable, long-term position



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



- You have never worked in short-term rental or Airbnb operations

- You have not directly used Hospitable, Notion, and Slack

- Your experience with these tools is old, limited, or only observational

- You need manager approval for every routine decision

- You struggle to write natural, professional guest messages

- You wait for problems to become emergencies before taking action

- You avoid responsibility or fail to document your work

- You are looking for a temporary role or side gig



ONLY APPLY IF YOU HAVE DIRECT STR OR AIRBNB EXPERIENCE AND HANDS-ON EXPERIENCE WITH OUR CORE SOFTWARE.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications that do not follow every instruction below will not be reviewed.



The first line of your application must contain only this word:



FRONTLINE



Then answer the following questions using the same numbers:



1. What is the maximum number of active short-term rental units you personally supported simultaneously? Do not provide the company’s total portfolio unless you personally handled every unit.



2. How many years of direct STR or Airbnb operations experience do you have? Briefly describe your core daily responsibilities.



3. Do you have direct, hands-on experience with Hospitable? State how long you used it, when you last used it, and the specific tasks you personally completed in Hospitable.



4. Do you have direct, hands-on experience with Notion? State how long you used it, when you last used it, and how you used it during daily operations.



5. Do you have direct, hands-on experience with Slack? State how long you used it, when you last used it, and how you used it to coordinate with an operations team.



6. Have you used SuiteOp? If yes, explain how long ago, for how long, and what you personally did with it. SuiteOp experience is a bonus, not a requirement.



7. What routine STR decisions were you authorized to make without manager approval? Provide two specific examples.



8. Write the exact message you would send in response to this guest. Do not explain your actions—write only the guest-facing response:



“Hi, it’s 10:45 PM. We just arrived. The AC is broken, we can’t find parking, and I want a refund!”



9. A cleaner was supposed to finish a property by 2:00 PM but has not confirmed completion. A guest is checking in at 4:00 PM, and the cleaner has not responded to your first message in 30 minutes. Walk us through the exact steps you would take next.



10. Which shift are you applying for: Morning, Evening, or Flexible? Confirm that you can consistently work your selected schedule six days per week and explain how you will maintain it long-term.



11. Confirm that you are open to a two-week paid trial.



12. Include a 45–60 second voice note describing the most difficult after-hours STR issue you personally handled. Explain what happened, the first three actions you took, what you communicated to the guest, and the final outcome.



Provide a working, publicly accessible link to your recording. We are evaluating the clarity and substance of your answer—not your accent or recording quality.



We pay biweekly, on time, every time. We also provide 13th-month pay and genuine advancement opportunities for team members who consistently perform at a high level.



If you want a stable, long-term role with a growing company—and you have genuine short-term rental experience—we would like to hear from you.

The Olinda shop — make Truffaux impossible to miss on Google when anyone in Victoria, or any tourist heading for the Dandenong Ranges, searches for hats or things to do. Maps, local SEO, reviews, tourism.

Truffaux worldwide — turn my 20 years of Panama hat knowledge into the internet's best hat content: articles, video, Reels, answers. Authority that converts to global online sales.

title: AI Content Creator & Video Editor – Meta Ads
description:
We are a successful UK supplement brand with an established presence on Amazon, and we're now preparing to expand our brand through Meta advertising.



We're looking for a talented and creative AI Content Creator & Video Editor to join our team full-time and help us produce high-quality, performance-focused content for
 and Instagram advertising.



The Role



We're looking for someone who is highly skilled in AI video content creation and understands how AI can be used to create a wide variety of engaging advertising content.



This is not limited to AI-generated UGC.



We want someone who can take a product, concept or creative brief and use AI tools to turn it into compelling video content.



Examples could include:



Educational AI videos

Product explainers

AI-generated lifestyle content

AI UGC-style content

Animated educational content

Visual demonstrations of ingredients or product benefits

AI-generated B-roll

Infographic and motion-graphic style videos

Storytelling and problem/solution ads

Product-focused videos

Voiceover-led educational ads

Other creative AI concepts that could perform well on Meta



We want someone who actively follows developments in AI video and is constantly experimenting with new tools, formats and creative possibilities.



Alongside AI content creation, you will also be responsible for editing UGC footage supplied by our creators.



This will include taking raw UGC and turning it into multiple advertising variations by:



Testing different hooks and opening sequences

Changing CTAs

Creating different lengths and cuts

Changing pacing and structure

Adding B-roll and product footage

Adding captions, graphics and overlays

Incorporating AI-generated elements where appropriate

Creating multiple variations of winning creatives



The aim is to get significantly more creative output from the content we already have while continually producing completely new concepts using AI.



Who We're Looking For



Ideally, you will have:



Strong experience with AI video generation and AI content creation

Excellent video editing skills

Experience creating content for Meta /
 / Instagram ads

A good understanding of hooks, attention, retention and direct-response advertising

Experience editing UGC advertising

The ability to turn one piece of content into multiple creative variations

Experience using a range of current AI video, image and voice tools

A strong creative eye and ability to come up with your own ideas

Good written and spoken English

Strong attention to detail

The ability to work independently and meet deadlines



Experience in supplements, health, wellness or e-commerce is highly preferred.



We would particularly like to hear from candidates who have previously created AI content for supplement brands.



Salary & Position



$800–$1,000 USD per month



This is a full-time, long-term position.



We're looking for someone who can become an important part of our creative team as we grow our Meta advertising.



For the right person, this is an opportunity to work in a role where you will be encouraged to experiment with new AI tools and creative formats rather than simply following the same editing templates every day.



How to Apply



Please include examples of your previous work in your application.



We would especially like to see examples of:



AI-generated video content

Educational or explainer-style AI content

Supplement / health / wellness advertising

Meta ads

UGC videos you've edited

Creative uses of AI that go beyond standard AI UGC



Please also answer the following:



1. Which AI video/image tools do you currently use?



2. Have you previously created content for supplement, health or wellness brands? If yes, please provide examples.



3. If we gave you a supplement product and asked you to create 5 completely different AI video concepts for Meta, what types of videos would you consider creating?



Applications that do not include examples of previous work will not be considered.



We're looking for someone who is genuinely excited about AI content creation and wants to push what is possible with AI advertising.

title: Content and Community Manager · LinkedIn, Instagram, X
description:
Who I am

I'm Jovan. I have spent more than twenty years in customer experience, first on the front line taking the calls and the chats myself, and then running the teams that do it. I now run a consultancy called Efficiency Labs with a high ticket offer called Elite CX, and the short version of what I do is that I help software founders stop losing customers to bad support.



The business is me. There is no team yet, which is exactly why I am writing this.



What this role actually is

I need one person who takes the content and community side of the business off my hands so that I can spend my time on clients and on calls with leads. That means making and posting content on LinkedIn, Instagram and X, and being the first reply to people who message us.



There is a real admin side to this too, so the calendar, the inbox, the invoices and the follow ups would sit with you as well. I would rather be honest about that up front than have you find out in week two.



Read the hard part first

I would rather you opt out now than in month three, so here is the honest version.



- This is up to four hours a day and no more, at least to begin with, and it is paid by the hour. If you need full time income right now, that is not where this starts, though it is realistically where we get to in a few months.

- At some point you will be working United States Eastern hours, once you are handling more of the conversations with leads. - I am in Central European Time and around from six in the morning until ten at night, so anything that does not need you live with a lead can happen inside those hours instead.

- Mostly weekdays, and some weekends depending on what is running. I am not going to promise you there is never any weekend work.

- I care an unusual amount about writing. Your grammar, tone and rhythm will get corrected repeatedly until they are right, and you cannot take that as a personal attack, because constant specific feedback is quite often the only way to learn this work.

- You are joining a company of one. There is no manager above me to escalate to and nobody is going to chase you, but I do not want to be chasing anybody either. What I need is somebody proactive who pushes me and moves things forward without being asked.



Who I am actually looking for

I need somebody I can genuinely rely on, the kind of person who quietly builds a system for something because the way it was being done annoyed them.



- You take ownership. You spot the problem before I do and you deal with it rather than waiting to be told.

- You figure things out on your own first. Between Google, YouTube and AI you can solve most of what lands on your desk, and you come to me only after you have genuinely tried.

- You are discreet. What happens inside the business stays inside the business, and that is not negotiable.

- You read between the lines. You pick up what I meant rather than only what I typed.

- You want to grow into being my sidekick, not just work through a list.



Now the part I think makes it worth your time

- You would be the first person I have ever hired into my own company, which means you learn this business from the inside instead of being handed a task list and left alone with it. I will share everything I know from more than twenty years of doing this work, and I mean properly teach you rather than send you a link.



That covers how elite customer support really works, operations and project management, and everything I have done across my career and the parts I was genuinely good at.



Done properly this is a path to becoming an expert in customer care, and there is room to grow inside this company as it grows. Tell me what direction you want and I will aim the training at it on purpose.



What you would do

Write and publish content on LinkedIn, Instagram and X, working from my voice notes, my calls and your own ideas

Repurpose what performs into the other platforms rather than posting the same thing three times

Schedule it all and check how it looks on a phone before it goes out

Reply to people who message us, qualify them, keep a simple record of what was said, and hand me the ones worth a conversation

Build research and prospect lists to a brief

Guard my calendar and my inbox, and tell me when I have dropped something



What you need

- Written American English at a near native level.

- Spoken English at a comfortable conversational level. You do not need to be a polished presenter, but you need to hold a call with me without either of us straining.

- Genuinely advanced with Claude or ChatGPT. Not "I have used it." I mean you work with these tools every day and you can tell the difference between a good output and one that only looks good. If your application reads like you pasted my questions straight into a chatbot, I will know, and that is an immediate no.

- Image design and basic video editing. Canva is fine for graphics, and for video I mean trimming, captions and cleanup, the kind of thing Instagram Edit handles. You do not have to be Tarantino, just good enough for social.

- Good soft skills and some feel for sales conversation, because you will be talking to people who might become clients.

- Real working knowledge of LinkedIn, Instagram and X, which means understanding why the same post does not work on all three.

- A reliable internet connection and a working setup for United States Eastern hours, with at least two to four hours a day where we genuinely overlap and can talk live.

- Organized enough that I never have to ask whether something got done.



- A big plus, though not required: any customer service or sales background at all.



Rate and hours

Up to seven US dollars an hour to start, depending on your skills. Paid hourly, up to four hours a day and a maximum of 120 hours a month at the moment. The hours are likely to grow over the next few months if this works for both of us.



How to apply

Record a short Loom video about yourself first. One hint, please do not write an AI script and read it to me. Just record yourself talking about who you are, what you are doing now, and what made you apply.



Then apply through this form: 



I read every application that follows the instructions. I ignore every one that does not :)

title: Inbound Sales & Accounts Receivable VA | Appointment Setting & Collections
description:
Full-Time | Remote | 40 Hours/Week | US Hours | Weekend Work Required



We are looking for a confident, reliable, and results-driven Virtual Assistant who can handle two important customer-facing responsibilities:



Weekend Inbound Sales + Weekday Accounts Receivable / Collections



This is a great opportunity for someone who is naturally good on the phone, enjoys talking with customers, knows how to close opportunities, and is also comfortable following up on past-due accounts.



You do not need to be an accountant or bookkeeper.



We are primarily looking for someone with strong phone communication, sales, customer service, appointment setting, or collections experience who can confidently handle both sides of the role.



YOUR WEEK WILL LOOK LIKE THIS

Saturday & Sunday — Inbound Sales



You’ll handle customers who are already contacting the business for pest-control services.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Phone Sales

Customer Service

Appointment Setting

Accounts Receivable

Collections

Billing Follow-Up

Call Centers

Home Services

CRM Management



Pest control or home-services experience is a strong plus, but it is not required.



We are much more interested in whether you can communicate, persuade, follow up, and get results.



YOU SHOULD BE:

Excellent in spoken and written English

Confident and natural on the phone

Friendly and professional with customers

Comfortable asking someone to make a buying decision

Comfortable discussing overdue balances and requesting payment

Persistent without being aggressive

A strong listener

Organized with follow-ups

Comfortable using a CRM

Coachable and willing to follow a proven process

Competitive and motivated by measurable goals

Reliable enough to consistently cover weekends



You must also have:



Reliable high-speed internet

A quiet home-working environment

A reliable computer and headset

Availability during the required US working hours

SCHEDULE



This is approximately 40 hours per week.



Saturday: Approximately 11 hours — Inbound Sales

Sunday: Approximately 9 hours — Inbound Sales

Monday–Friday: Approximately 20 total hours — AR / Collections



Weekend availability is required for this position.



Please do not apply if you are unable to consistently work Saturdays and Sundays.



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



This is a performance-oriented role.



For inbound sales, success may be measured by:



Calls answered

Conversion rate

Inspections or services booked

Follow-up completion



For Accounts Receivable, success may be measured by:



Customers contacted

Follow-ups completed

Payment commitments secured

Collections results

Accurate CRM documentation



We are looking for someone who enjoys knowing exactly what success looks like and is comfortable being accountable to measurable results.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer these 4 questions:



1. Tell us about your experience with phone sales, appointment setting, customer service, or collections. What type of calls did you handle?



2. A homeowner calls asking about pest control but says, “I need to think about it.” What would you say or do next?



3. A customer has an overdue balance and tells you they cannot pay the full amount today. How would you handle the conversation?



4. Send a 60–90 second video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be good at BOTH sales calls and collections calls.



We are looking for someone who is confident on the phone, dependable, coachable, and motivated by results.



If you enjoy talking with customers, solving problems, closing opportunities, and following through until something gets done, we would love to hear from you.

title: Technical Account Engineer (MSP) – Infrastructure, Cloud & Projects
description:
We are seeking a consultative and technically proficient Technical Account Engineer (MSP) to serve as the primary technical advisor and relationship lead for a portfolio of business clients.

 

Are you an ambitious IT professional who loves solving hands-on technical challenges, learning modern cloud and infrastructure stacks, and helping businesses make smart technology decisions? If you have solid IT fundamentals, a strong work ethic, clear communication skills, and a desire to grow into an elite Technical Account Engineer, we want to invest in you.



We believe curiosity, logical problem-solving, and trainability matter far more than checking every single technical box. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical engineering and client advocacy, helping design and implement practical infrastructure upgrades, cloud migrations, and security improvements for our US business clients. We provide dedicated mentorship, hands-on project exposure, and company-sponsored certifications to help you master advanced cloud architectures, security frameworks, and client technical guidance.



What You Will Do

* Technical Guidance & Infrastructure Reviews: Collaborate with client stakeholders and US account teams to review IT environment health, identify potential technical risks, and help plan proactive upgrades.

* Hands-on Implementation & Modernization: Assist with and execute core infrastructure upgrades, including Microsoft 365 migrations, Azure/Microsoft Entra ID configurations, network switch and firewall setups, backup validation, and endpoint security deployments.

* Technical Scoping & Project Planning: Work alongside Project Specialists and Account Managers to assess client infrastructure, evaluate technical dependencies, estimate engineering effort, and draft clear project scopes.

* Standardization & Documentation: Ensure smooth operational handoffs to the service delivery team by building structured network diagrams, configurations, and standard operating procedures in a documentation platform.

* Continuous Technical Growth: Expand your engineering toolkit through hands-on project execution, cross-training with senior specialists, and structured certification roadmaps.



What We Are Looking For



* Smart & Fast Learner: Strong grasp of core IT fundamentals (Windows Server, Active Directory/Entra ID, Microsoft 365, DNS, DHCP, and basic networking concepts) and a natural curiosity to explore how things work.

* Trainable & Solutions-Oriented: You do not need to know every technology on day one. We value the drive to research solutions, learn from senior engineers, embrace feedback, and quickly master new systems.

* Clear, Professional Communication: Ability to explain technical setups and project updates clearly and professionally in English, both in written documentation and in conversations with business clients.

* Hands-on Technical Background: 1 to 3+ years in IT support or systems administration (L2 support, junior systems engineer, or technical support specialist), preferably with some exposure to multi-client or MSP environments.

* Ownership & Reliability: Dependable, organized, and focused on delivering clean project cutovers with minimal downtime.

* Schedule & Setup: Comfortable working US business hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST / overnight in the Philippines) from a dedicated home office with reliable high-speed internet and power backup.



Nice to Have (Not Required — We Will Train You!)



* Prior experience working within a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment or using RMM/PSA tools.

* Hands-on exposure to firewall configurations (Ubiquiti, Cisco, Fortinet), VLANs, VPNs, or tenant-to-tenant migrations.

* Foundational industry certifications (CompTIA Network+/Security+, Microsoft Certified: Fundamentals / Azure Administrator, or CCNA).

* Familiarity with centralized documentation platforms.



Why Join Cloudavize?



Work directly with US business leaders and help implement practical, high-impact technology solutions.

* Combine client-facing technical advisory with hands-on infrastructure engineering projects.

* Collaborate with a supportive US and global team of account managers, project specialists, and service delivery engineers.

* Clear career development pathways toward Senior Technical Account Management, Solutions Architecture, or Engineering Leadership.

 

What Sets Us Apart?



* We believe in creating an environment where our team members can thrive both professionally and personally:

* Performance-Based Rewards: Monthly profit sharing and bonuses for high-performing team members.

* Continuous Learning: We invest in your professional growth with company-paid certifications and technical training.

* Collaborative Environment: Work with a team that values your input, respects your expertise, and supports your success.

* Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of working remotely from home while delivering high-value, impactful projects.

 

How to Apply



If you are a consultative, technically strong IT professional who enjoys leading strategic client conversations and executing modern infrastructure projects, apply now!

1. Subject Line Requirement: Submit your application and include the numbers (2028) in your
 subject line. This helps us ensure you have read the complete job post.

2. Resume/CV: Attach your updated CV with complete tenureship details (or provide a direct link to your CV). Applications submitted without a CV will not be considered.

3. Must be in NCR or nearby location.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Experienced Real Estate Cold Caller / ISA – Motivated Seller Leads | $6–$7/hr + Appointment & Closing Bonuses
description:
OnlyOffers is a Chicago-based real estate solutions and home-buying company.



We speak with homeowners who may be dealing with situations such as:



* A property that needs major repairs

* Problem tenants or nonpaying occupants

* An inherited or probate property

* Pre-foreclosure or financial pressure

* A vacant or boarded property

* Tax or code issues

* An unwanted rental property

* Divorce, relocation or another life transition

* A desire to sell as-is without preparing the property for the traditional market



Depending on the homeowner’s situation, our local team may discuss a direct purchase, an as-is sale, a traditional real estate listing or another legitimate option.



We are not looking for someone who pressures homeowners or simply reads a script. We need someone who listens carefully, asks intelligent questions, recognizes genuine motivation and schedules qualified conversations for our local team.



This is intended to be a stable, long-term position with the opportunity to grow into a Senior ISA or Lead Manager as OnlyOffers expands.



-----



YOUR ROLE



You will be the first voice many homeowners hear from OnlyOffers.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Making outbound calls to property owners using our company-provided dialer

* Having professional, natural conversations with Chicago-area homeowners

* Identifying whether the owner is open to discussing a sale

* Asking appropriate discovery questions about:

    * Reason for considering a sale

    * Desired timeline

    * Property condition and needed repairs

    * Whether the property is occupied, vacant or tenant-occupied

    * Tenant or eviction-related complications

    * Ownership and other decision-makers

    * Price expectations, when appropriate

* Recognizing motivated sellers without forcing or misleading them

* Scheduling qualified appointments or callbacks with our acquisitions or real estate team

* Completing assigned follow-up calls

* Sending approved SMS or
 follow-ups through company systems when assigned

* Recording accurate notes, dispositions, tags and follow-up tasks in the CRM

* Keeping every lead organized so no legitimate opportunity is lost

* Submitting an accurate end-of-shift report

* Immediately recording and honoring every do-not-call request

* Following all OnlyOffers calling, privacy and compliance procedures



We provide the lead lists, dialer, CRM, scripts, training and qualification process.



-----



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO



You will not:



* Quote a cash offer or property value

* Estimate what a property is worth

* Negotiate purchase prices or contract terms

* Give legal, tax, foreclosure or eviction advice

* Promise that OnlyOffers will purchase a property

* Misrepresent the company or the purpose of the call

* Continue calling someone who has asked not to be contacted



Those matters are handled by our acquisitions team, licensed real estate professionals or appropriate third-party professionals.



Your responsibility is to start a genuine conversation, collect accurate information and make a professional handoff.



-----



WHAT COUNTS AS A QUALIFIED APPOINTMENT



A $25 appointment bonus is earned only when all of the following are true:



1. You spoke with the property owner or a confirmed decision-maker.

2. The property is within an approved OnlyOffers market or campaign.

3. The homeowner expressed genuine openness to selling or discussing available options.

4. There is a real timeline, reason, problem or circumstance behind the potential sale.

5. You collected the required property and seller information.

6. Clear and accurate notes were entered in the CRM.

7. The homeowner agreed to a specific appointment or callback time.

8. The scheduled conversation was actually held by our team.



Duplicate leads, existing active leads, fake appointments, homeowners who were misled or appointments missing required information do not qualify for the bonus.



Quality is more important than simply placing appointments on the calendar.



-----



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



After training and ramp-up, reasonable performance targets may include:



* Consistent high-volume outbound activity during assigned calling blocks

* Approximately 10–25 real homeowner conversations per day, depending on list and dialer performance

* Approximately 3–8 legitimate seller opportunities per week

* Approximately 1–4 qualified appointments held per week

* Accurate same-day CRM notes and follow-up tasks

* Reliable attendance and punctuality

* Professional communication with the OnlyOffers team

* Immediate and accurate handling of do-not-call requests



These targets may be adjusted based on list quality, connection rate, campaign type and dialer setup. We do not reward meaningless dials or unqualified leads.



-----



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



To be considered, you must have:



* At least one year of outbound calling, appointment setting or inside-sales experience

* Previous experience calling U.S. homeowners

* Previous U.S. real-estate cold-calling experience

* Experience identifying seller motivation, timeline, condition and price expectations

* Experience handling objections without sounding robotic or aggressive

title: Direct Response Video Editor for Paid Social Ads — High Volume + AI Savvy
description:
We’re an affiliate marketing team running paid social campaigns at scale, and we’re looking for high-output video editors who understand direct-response advertising.

This is NOT a role where we hand you perfectly organized footage and tell you exactly where to make every cut.

We want editors who can take a concept, script, reference ad, or rough direction and turn it into a finished ad independently.

You should be comfortable taking something like:

“Here are 3 winning ads in this vertical. Create 5 new concepts inspired by these without simply copying them.”

…and running with it.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll primarily create short-form video ads for platforms like
, TikTok, Snapchat, and other paid social channels.

Depending on the assignment, you may receive:

Winning/reference ads

Scripts

Hooks or angles

Landing pages

Raw footage

A general creative concept

From there, we expect you to be resourceful.

That may mean:

Finding relevant B-roll

Generating AI footage/images

Creating AI voiceovers with tools like ElevenLabs

Sourcing clips when appropriate

Adding captions, graphics, overlays, sound effects, etc.

Reworking hooks and pacing

Creating multiple genuinely different variations of a concept

Identifying ways to improve the source material rather than blindly copying it

You need to be comfortable using AI as part of your editing workflow.

What We're Looking For

The biggest thing we care about is performance creative, not cinematic editing.

You should understand concepts like:

Hooks

Pattern interrupts

UGC/native-style ads

Direct-response pacing

Advertorial-style creative

Keeping attention in the first 1–3 seconds

Creating variations that are actually different

Iterating on winning ads

Making ads feel native to the platform rather than overly produced

Experience editing affiliate, lead generation, e-commerce, supplement, finance, insurance, or other direct-response ads is a major plus.

Autonomy Is Important

We don't want someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every ad.

If we give you an idea and you're missing a piece of footage, we expect you to figure out how to get it.

If an AI-generated clip would make the ad better, generate it.

If the voiceover needs to be created, create it.

If the reference ad gives you an idea for a stronger variation, make it.

Resourcefulness is one of the biggest things we're hiring for.

Volume & Turnaround

This is an ongoing position with a consistent creative workload.

We care heavily about:

Speed + quality + variation.

We'll establish a weekly output target together, but you should be comfortable producing creatives at volume without every ad looking like a slightly modified version of the last one.

Fast turnaround is extremely important.

Performance Feedback

Your ads won't disappear into a folder after you make them.

We actively run and track these creatives.

Each editor's ads are labeled so we can see performance by editor and creative.

That means you'll get actual feedback based on:

Spend

CPA

CTR

Conversion performance

Winning hooks/angles

Which creative styles are working

Over time, we expect you to use that information to make better ads.

If your creatives consistently perform, there is significant opportunity to grow with us and receive more work.

Paid Trial

We're hiring several editors initially and will give each editor similar paid trial assignments.

We're evaluating:

Creative quality

Turnaround time

Ability to follow directions

Resourcefulness

How much you improve/transform the source material

Ability to create genuinely different variations

Understanding of direct-response advertising

Communication

Ability to work independently

The strongest editors will move into ongoing roles with consistent weekly volume.

To Apply

Please send:

3–5 examples of direct-response ads you've edited. Please don't send a giant portfolio. Show us your best relevant work.

Tell us what types of paid ads you've edited before.

Tell us which AI tools you currently use for editing, voice, images, or video generation.

Tell us approximately how many 30–60 second ads you can realistically produce per week.

Tell us your typical turnaround time for one ad once you receive the assignment.

IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word “PERFORMANCE” so we know you read the entire post.

We're looking to hire immediately and will be selecting multiple editors for paid trials.

title: Sales Performance & Reporting Coordinator
description:
# Sales Performance & Reporting Coordinator



**First Response Sales** is looking for a highly organized, technically capable and data-driven **Sales Performance & Reporting Coordinator** to support our internal sales operations and client accounts.



This role sits at the centre of our sales systems.



You will help make sure our CRM data is accurate, sales teams are following process, client dashboards are up to date, leads are being followed up correctly, reporting is accurate and management has clear visibility over what is happening across each account.



We work primarily with Australian businesses in the **Property Advisory, Buyer’s Agency, Mortgage Broking and high-ticket service industries**.



This is ideal for someone who enjoys **sales operations, CRM management, dashboards, reporting, systems and organisation**.



## What You’ll Be Responsible For



### Sales Performance Reporting



You will help us track and report on the performance of appointment setters, closers and overall sales pipelines.



You will monitor metrics such as:



* Leads received

* Leads contacted

* Calls made

* Contact rate

* Qualified conversations

* Appointments booked

* Booking rate

* Show rate

* No-show rate

* Qualification rate

* Close rate

* Sales generated

* Revenue generated

* Pipeline value

* Lead source performance

* Setter performance

* Closer performance

* Weekly and monthly conversion trends



You will help prepare **daily, weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting** across our client accounts.



## Google Looker Studio Dashboards



A major part of this role will be building and maintaining **client-facing performance dashboards using Google Looker Studio**.



You should be able to turn sales data into clear, professional dashboards that a business owner can understand quickly.



Dashboards may include:



* Lead volume

* Lead sources

* Calls and activities

* Appointments booked

* Show and no-show rates

* Setter KPIs

* Closer KPIs

* Close rates

* Sales revenue

* Conversion rates

* Pipeline value

* Weekly and monthly performance

* Individual team member performance



You should be comfortable working with data from sources such as:



* Google Sheets

* GoHighLevel

* CRM exports

* CSV files

* Other sales platforms



Experience building dashboards from scratch is highly regarded.



## CRM & Pipeline Management



You will help keep our client CRMs clean, accurate and organised.



This includes:



* Checking that new leads have been assigned correctly

* Making sure opportunities are in the correct pipeline stages

* Checking that setters and closers are updating lead outcomes

* Ensuring notes are being entered properly

* Monitoring follow-up dates

* Identifying leads that have not been contacted

* Identifying stale opportunities

* Identifying leads sitting without a next action

* Checking no-shows and reschedules

* Ensuring closed sales are recorded correctly

* Maintaining lead ownership

* Checking lead source attribution

* Identifying duplicated or incorrectly entered records



We use **GoHighLevel extensively**, so previous experience with GHL is highly regarded.



You do not need to be a full GoHighLevel developer, but you should be very comfortable working inside a CRM.



## Sales Team Accountability



You will support the Sales Operations Manager by helping make sure setters and closers are following the agreed process.



This may include:



* Checking daily dial activity

* Checking lead follow-up

* Monitoring booked appointments

* Monitoring show rates

* Checking closer outcomes

* Identifying missing CRM notes

* Following up internally when data is missing

* Maintaining KPI scorecards

* Flagging underperformance

* Highlighting opportunities that need immediate attention

* Preparing performance data for sales meetings



You will not be expected to personally coach or manage salespeople.



Your role is to make sure the **data, systems and reporting are accurate enough for management to make decisions quickly**.



## Sales Administration



You will also assist with general sales operations administration.



This can include:



* Preparing reports before sales meetings

* Maintaining Google Sheets

* Updating trackers

* Organising client files

* Updating internal SOPs

* Maintaining sales documents

* Assisting with new client onboarding

* Assisting with setter and closer onboarding

* Importing lead databases

* Cleaning lead lists

* Managing CSV files

* Checking calendars

* Updating pipeline information

* Organising sales team information

* Helping maintain Slack channels

* Maintaining internal checklists

* Assisting with client reporting

* General administrative support for the Sales Operations Manager



## Systems & Tools



Experience with the following will be highly regarded:



* **Google Looker Studio**

* **GoHighLevel**

* **Google Sheets**

* Google Docs

* Google Drive

* Slack

* Zapier

* CRM systems

* Reporting platforms

* Spreadsheet formulas and data organisation



Advanced Google Sheets knowledge is a major advantage.



Experience with formulas, filters, pivot tables, data cleaning and reporting is highly regarded.



## Minimum Requirements



We are looking for someone with:



* Previous experience in sales operations, sales administration, CRM management, reporting or a similar role

* Strong Google Sheets skills

* Experience building or maintaining dashboards

* Experience working with CRM systems

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent organisational skills

* Strong written English

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to identify mistakes without being told

* Strong problem-solving skills

* Confidence working with sales data and KPIs

* Reliable internet connection

* Ability to work during Australian business hours when required



## Highly Regarded



You will have a strong advantage if you have experience with:



* Google Looker Studio

* GoHighLevel

* Australian businesses

* Appointment-setting teams

* High-ticket sales

* Property Advisory businesses

* Buyer’s Agencies

* Mortgage Broking businesses

* Sales reporting

* Sales dashboards

* Lead management

* Sales pipeline management



## The Type of Person We Want



We are looking for someone who naturally notices when something does not look right.



You should be someone who asks questions like:



“Why hasn't this lead been contacted?”



“Why is this opportunity still sitting in this stage?”



“Why does the dashboard say 14 bookings but the CRM says 17?”



“Why hasn't this closer updated the outcome?”



“Why did the show rate suddenly drop this week?”



“Where are these leads coming from?”



We want someone who does not simply complete tasks.



We want someone who **helps keep the sales operation under control**.



You should be organised, proactive, detail-oriented and comfortable taking ownership of your responsibilities.



## About First Response Sales



First Response Sales helps businesses build, manage and improve their sales operations.



Our work includes:



* Appointment setting

* Setter management

* Sales operations management

* CRM optimisation

* Lead management

* Sales reporting

* Sales dashboards

* Follow-up systems

* Pipeline management

* Sales team accountability

* Sales processes and systems



Our primary market is Australian **Property Advisory, Buyer’s Agency, Mortgage Broking and high-ticket service businesses**.



As First Response Sales grows, there will be opportunities for strong performers to take on more responsibility across client accounts and internal operations.



## How to Apply

Schedule medical, dental and other appointments

Manage school forms, accounts, paperwork and deadlines

Submit claims, receipts and documentation through our insurance portal and follow up until they're resolved

Set up and order our family holiday cards through Minted

Coordinate household services, repairs and appointments

Keep track of administrative tasks that require follow-up

Occasionally order/return supplies for business



Some of this work involves confidential family information. Trustworthiness and discretion are essential.



Who I'm looking for



Excellent spoken English. You will make phone calls to doctors, schools, insurance companies and businesses in the United States. An accent is completely fine. You need to understand conversational English easily and speak clearly and confidently.



Resourceful and independent. If I say, “Our health insurance didn’t reimburse this claim. Can you figure out why?” I want you to investigate, determine what is needed, and move it toward resolution.



Persistent. If someone doesn’t respond, you follow up. If a claim is missing a document, you figure out what document is needed. I shouldn’t need to remember to remind you.



Good judgment. You should be comfortable making routine decisions while recognizing when something needs my approval. If you aren't sure whether you're authorized to spend money, agree to something, or share information, you stop and ask.



Organized. You can manage multiple open tasks, deadlines and follow-ups without losing track of them.



Requirements:

Several years of Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant or high-level VA experience

Experience working with US-based clients

Excellent spoken and written English

Comfortable making phone calls during US Eastern business hours

Strong internet connection and reliable computer

Comfortable learning unfamiliar websites and systems

Two professional references from previous clients or employers

Willing to complete a paid trial

Willing to complete identity/background verification before receiving access to sensitive accounts



AI tools are welcome. I care about the quality and accuracy of your work, your judgment, and your ability to get things done.



Hours & Pay



This will begin as a part-time position, likely around 10 hours per week, with the possibility of growing over time.



Some availability during US Eastern business hours is required for phone calls, but much of the work can be completed on your own schedule.



$8–$12 USD/hour depending on experience.



How to apply



Please answer these questions:



1. Tell me about the client or executive you supported for the longest period. How long did you work together, and what kinds of things did you manage for them?



2. Imagine I tell you: “My child’s school needs an updated immunization form by Friday. Please take care of it.” Walk me through what you would do.



3. Are you comfortable making phone calls to US doctors, insurance companies, schools and businesses? Tell me about your previous experience doing this.



4. Please also include a 1–2 minute voice recording : imagine you're calling my child's (Sam's) school to let them know that a grandparent (Mary) is picking them up today. Record what you would say. 



Final candidates will be asked for two professional references and invited to complete a paid trial.



At the very beginning of your application, write the name of your favorite fruit so I know you read the full posting.
