title: Facebook Ads Direct Response Video Editor
description:
QUICK SUMMARY



Daily Output: 3–4 concepts per day including revisions

Video Length: Typically 60–200 seconds

Focus: High-converting product ads using a mix of AI-enhanced and traditional editing workflows

Location: Remote

Pay: $10 per completed minute of video for the first month → $15 per completed minute from the second month onwards

Bonus Scheme: Up to $1,000 for winning ads based on performance



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a high-level AI Video Editor / Creative who understands direct response advertising, premium product cinematography and fast-paced content production.



This role is not purely AI-generated content.



While AI-generated b-roll and AI workflows will be used at the start to increase speed and scale, our long-term expectation is that concepts will typically contain only around 10–20% AI-generated footage, with the remaining majority being traditional high-quality b-roll, stock integration, motion graphics, editing and polished ad creative techniques.



We expect 3–4 strong concepts per day, including revisions and iteration based on feedback.



Speed matters, but realism, conversion quality, pacing and attention to detail matter more.



You should understand how to create ads that feel premium, believable, emotionally engaging and performance-driven — not generic “AI-looking” content.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Daily Concept Production

Produce 3–4 ad concepts daily ranging from 60–200 seconds, including revisions and improvements based on feedback.



AI-Assisted Product Cinematography

Generate ultra-realistic AI product b-roll when needed, including clean lighting, realistic textures, cinematic camera movement and seamless integration into real-world edits.



Traditional Editing & B-Roll Integration

Work heavily with real footage, stock footage, motion design, pacing, transitions, subtitles, sound design and conversion-focused editing techniques to create polished final ads.



AI Character & Voice Integration

Create and manage realistic AI talking characters, lip-syncing, voiceovers and emotional delivery when required.



End-to-End Post Production

Handle scripting support, prompting, editing, upscaling, sound design, colour grading, pacing, revisions and final export delivery.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL STACK



You should already be highly experienced with most of the following tools:



AI Video Generation



Runway Gen-3 / Gen-4

Kling

Luma Dream Machine



Voice / Character Tools



HeyGen

ElevenLabs

D-ID



Image Generation



Midjourney v6+

Leonardo.ai



Editing & Post Production



Adobe Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve

CapCut Desktop



AI Enhancement



Topaz Video AI

REQUIREMENTS



Speed & Efficiency

You must be capable of turning concepts into polished deliverables quickly while maintaining quality and realism.



Understanding of Advertising

You should understand engaging shots, pacing, hooks, retention editing, emotional storytelling and what makes ads convert.



Attention to Detail

You must be able to identify and fix bad AI outputs, unrealistic movement, awkward lip-syncing, poor lighting, incorrect accents, unnatural emotion or low-quality visual details.



Strong English & Audio Awareness

Do not apply if you cannot clearly distinguish between British and American accents, create emotionally accurate AI voiceovers or direct voice delivery properly.



Work Ethic & Communication

Communication, reliability, speed and consistency are critical. This is a high-performance environment with high expectations.



PAY



Compensation is based on completed video output.



First Month

$10 per completed minute of video



Second Month Onwards

$15 per completed minute of video



The more completed video work you produce, the more you can earn.



BONUS SCHEME FOR WINNING ADS



On top of the normal per-minute pay, there are additional bonuses for ads you create that become winning ads.



$200 Winning Ad Bonus

Any winning ad spending over $200 per day at a 1.8 ROAS or above = $200 bonus



$1,000 Winning Ad Bonus

Any winning ad spending $1,000 per day at a 2.0 ROAS or above = $1,000 bonus



These bonuses are paid on top of your normal per-minute video compensation.



HOW TO APPLY



Please provide:



A portfolio or folder showcasing your best AI-assisted video work and product ad creatives

Examples of product b-roll and/or talking character content

A list of the AI tools you currently use or pay for regularly



Application Requirement



To prove you have strong attention to detail, start your application or cover letter with the secret word:



NEURAL

title: Video Editor (Fast Turnaround / Simple Commentary Style)
description:
Job Type: Contract / Freelance (Ongoing)



Rate: $1.50 per video minute (Final length of the video)



Turnaround Time: Strict 12-hour deadline from the time raw footage is provided.



About the Role:

We are looking for a reliable, efficient video editor to handle a new, streamlined video editing tier for our channel. The content is primarily political/news commentary featuring a single speaker talking directly to the camera. We need clean, fast-paced edits delivered quickly.



Requirements & Style:

Simple & Clean: No heavy motion graphics or complex animations required.



Pacing: Tighten up the commentary. Cut out long breaths, pauses, "ums," and dead air to keep the viewer engaged.



B-Roll & Visuals: Insert relevant static elements when mentioned by the host (e.g., screenshots of news articles, social media posts/tweets, maps, or short news clips).



Text On-Screen: Lower thirds for speaker names or occasional text highlights for key emphasis.



Audio: Clean audio, balanced sound levels, and optional subtle background music if needed.

title: LinkedIn Outreach and Personal Branding Assistant
description:
Already good at writing personalised DMs? Put that skill to work with My Content Pal.

We serve seven- and eight-figure brands, helping founders build their presence on LinkedIn. We’re looking for someone who can spot a relevant detail, write a natural message and keep conversations moving through thoughtful outreach.

You’ll publish approved content, write useful comments and start conversations for our clients. The client handles sales conversations and calls. You keep outreach organised and hand over opportunities clearly.



What you get

$1,050 monthly base for managing three client accounts, paid in USD.

Up to $600 in monthly performance bonuses across three accounts, bringing the total to $1,650 when all three accounts qualify.

A 30-day onboarding programme, with daily coaching calls with Craig in your first week and further coaching as you develop.

10 planned days off each year with your agreed monthly base fee unchanged. We arrange coverage ahead so you can switch off without sending DMs or monitoring accounts.

A five-day paid trial: $20 per completed day, up to three hours per day. That’s $100 for all five days, whether or not you’re hired.

The base is calculated at $350 per client account. You build up your account allocation after the trial, with your starting number of accounts, monthly base and timeline agreed before you start. The $1,050 monthly base applies once you manage three accounts.

Each account earns a flat $200 monthly bonus at eight confirmed sales-qualified leads. These are suitable prospects with a relevant need and confirmed interest in discussing the service. Replies alone don’t count. Below eight, there is no bonus; at eight or more, it remains $200. We agree on the qualification and confirmation rules in writing before bonuses begin.

Time-off eligibility, partial-year arrangements and how breaks affect performance bonuses are agreed in writing before you start. If a trial ends early, completed days and partial-day work are paid fairly.



What you’ll do

Find suitable prospects using clear buyer criteria and send personalised first-touch DMs.

Write relevant comments and replies in the client’s voice.

Publish approved posts and check formatting, names, facts and the correct account.

Send due follow-ups, stop when someone replies and flag opportunities for the client.

Keep accurate records so the next action and owner are clear.

Working targets include around 20 new DMs and 5–8 comments per account each weekday. We test volumes during the trial, with quality and account restrictions taking priority. Original post writing, design and sales calls are outside this role.



What you bring

You already have personalised DM experience and can write clear, natural English. You notice context, keep accounts organised and turn a clear brief into finished work. You can explain why a prospect fits, check your own messages and apply feedback to the next example.

We provide briefs, examples, tools and coaching. You don’t need to get everything right immediately. Ask when something is unclear, and build towards making routine decisions independently within agreed sending permissions.

You’ll need a quiet workspace, stable internet and a backup for power or connection drops.

Availability and workload

We estimate around 2½ hours of delivery per account each weekday, or 7½ hours across three accounts. These are planning estimates; we review the workload during the trial and adjust volumes or allocation if needed.

You must be online during agreed weekday windows for DMs and time-sensitive engagement. We confirm those windows and their time zone before you start.

This role won’t suit you if

You’re learning personalised outreach from scratch.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
# Head of Marketing & Agent Growth



**Company:** Confidential Real Estate Brokerage

**Department:** Marketing & Agent Growth

**Reports To:** CEO

**Location:** Remote, with occasional travel for meetings, trainings, and events

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Compensation:** Base salary plus performance-based compensation tied to marketing services revenue, client growth, retention, and agreed marketing outcomes.



## About the Company



The Company is a growing, relationship-first real estate brokerage focused on helping agents build stronger and more sustainable businesses through leadership, coaching, marketing, technology, AI, systems, and community.



The Marketing Services Division provides done-for-you marketing and personal-brand support to help agents stay visible, build relationships, strengthen their brands, and generate new business opportunities.



## About the Role



The Head of Marketing & Agent Growth will lead the Company’s overall marketing strategy, support agents with their individual marketing needs, and drive the growth of the Marketing Services Division.



This is a strategic, relationship-driven, and revenue-focused role — not primarily a graphic design or production position.



The person in this role will work directly with agents to understand their businesses, identify marketing opportunities, recommend solutions, introduce appropriate marketing services, guide agents through the sales process, and oversee onboarding and fulfillment coordination.



## Key Responsibilities



### Marketing Strategy & Brand Leadership



* Develop and manage the Company’s overall marketing strategy.

* Create marketing plans that support recruiting, agent retention, training, company growth, culture, and brand awareness.

* Strengthen the Company’s positioning, messaging, and brand voice.

* Turn company goals into campaigns, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

* Lead campaign strategy, messaging, copywriting, and creative direction.

* Maintain marketing, content, training, and event calendars.

* Review campaign performance and recommend improvements.

* Ensure consistent branding across websites,
, social media, community platforms, YouTube, presentations, and agent communications.



### Agent Marketing & Relationship Management



* Serve as the primary marketing point of contact for agents.

* Build relationships through calls, meetings, trainings, events, and proactive outreach.

* Proactively reach out to agents instead of waiting for marketing requests.

* Understand each agent’s business, goals, challenges, market, budget, and marketing activity.

* Conduct marketing consultations, brand audits, website reviews, and strategy sessions.

* Identify gaps in branding, websites, social media, databases, content, and follow-up systems.

* Recommend practical marketing priorities based on each agent’s goals and resources.

* Help agents improve their personal brand, content,
 marketing, websites, social media, and database marketing.

* Follow up after consultations and help agents take action.

* Share recurring agent feedback and needs with leadership.



### Marketing Services Sales & Growth



* Lead the growth strategy for the Marketing Services Division.

* Understand all available services, pricing, deliverables, timelines, and processes.

* Introduce agents to marketing services through consultations,
, trainings, webinars, events, and direct outreach.

* Conduct discovery calls to understand agent needs.

* Recommend services based on the agent’s goals, budget, and marketing needs.

* Clearly explain services, pricing, timelines, responsibilities, and expectations.

* Confidently ask for the business when there is a strong fit.

* Follow up with prospects and move opportunities through the sales process.

* Maintain an organized pipeline of prospects, proposals, enrollments, active clients, renewals, and cancellations.

* Identify upsell and expansion opportunities with existing clients.

* Track leads, conversions, revenue, retention, and cancellations.



### Client Onboarding



* Own the onboarding experience for new marketing services clients.

* Welcome new clients and explain next steps.

* Confirm agreements, payments, services, timelines, responsibilities, and communication expectations.

* Collect required information, files, brand assets, and account access.

* Set up projects, tasks, deadlines, owners, and workflows in 
.

* Coordinate kickoff meetings and handoffs to the fulfillment team.

* Monitor the first stages of service delivery.

* Check in with clients during their first 30 days.

* Address onboarding concerns and coordinate solutions.

* Maintain organized client records and improve onboarding systems when needed.



### New Agent Marketing Onboarding



* Participate in the onboarding of newly affiliated agents.

* Introduce agents to available marketing tools, resources, trainings, templates, and support.

* Explain what is included with the brokerage and what is available separately through marketing services.

* Conduct an initial marketing assessment for each new agent.

* Identify the top marketing priorities they should focus on first.

* Coordinate agent bios, headshots, profiles, websites, welcome campaigns, and announcements when needed.

* Follow up after onboarding to encourage adoption and identify additional needs.



### Content, Messaging & Storytelling



* Lead messaging and content strategy for major company initiatives.

* Develop copy and messaging for recruiting, training, agent recognition, culture, announcements, and marketing services.

* Turn leadership ideas into campaigns,
s, scripts, website copy, presentations, and marketing briefs.

* Develop agent stories, success stories, and recognition content.

* Maintain a consistent, clear, personal, and human brand voice.



### Training & Event Marketing



* Lead marketing for trainings, webinars, workshops, meetings, and company events.

* Manage the training and event marketing calendar.

* Develop promotional messaging, registration campaigns, reminders, and follow-up communication.

* Coordinate graphics, presentations, landing pages,
s, social posts, and other event materials.

* Track registrations, attendance, participation, and feedback.



### Websites & Digital Platforms



* Oversee website strategy, structure, messaging, and content.

* Coordinate website updates, landing pages, agent pages, recruiting pages, and service pages.

* Maintain accurate information about services, pricing, processes, testimonials, FAQs, and calls to action.

* Improve website user experience and lead-generation opportunities.

* Coordinate advanced development or integrations with appropriate specialists.

* Ensure website leads are captured, tracked, and followed up.



### Community, YouTube & Agent Communication



* Manage the strategy and organization of the Company’s online agent community.

* Determine which trainings, resources, announcements, stories, and updates should be shared.

* Encourage agent participation through useful content and personal outreach.

* Oversee the Company’s YouTube content strategy.

* Coordinate video editing, thumbnails, uploads, titles, descriptions, and publishing with the production team.

* Coordinate messaging across
, community platforms, social media, meetings, and other channels.



### Marketing Operations & Project Management



* Build and manage marketing workflows in 
.

* Coordinate marketing projects from request through completion.

* Ensure every project has a clear owner, deadline, purpose, status, and next step.

* Coordinate designers, editors, website specialists, virtual assistants, contractors, and vendors.

* Manage revisions, approvals, missing information, and project communication.

* Build repeatable systems for campaigns, onboarding, trainings, websites, and recurring marketing activities.

* Document processes so work can be delegated and scaled.

* Monitor team capacity and identify bottlenecks.

* Maintain quality standards without becoming the main production person.



### Agent Engagement & Retention



* Create initiatives that help agents feel recognized, supported, and connected.

* Develop welcome campaigns, milestone recognition, anniversaries, success stories, and community highlights.

* Identify disengaged agents and coordinate thoughtful outreach.

* Gather feedback about marketing support, trainings, communication, and services.

* Recommend improvements that increase agent satisfaction, participation, productivity, and retention.



## Role Boundaries



The Head of Marketing & Agent Growth is responsible for strategy, relationships, sales, onboarding, coordination, and quality — not being the Company’s primary production person.



### This Role Owns



* Marketing strategy and brand direction.

* Agent marketing relationships and consultations.

* Agent outreach and marketing assessments.

* Marketing services discovery and sales conversations.

* Sales pipeline management and growth.

* Client onboarding.

* New-agent marketing onboarding.

* Campaign planning and creative direction.

* Copywriting and messaging.

* Training and event marketing.

* Website strategy and messaging.

* Marketing systems and workflows.

* Project coordination and team direction.

* Quality control and reporting.



### This Role May Coordinate but Does Not Need to Personally Execute



* High-volume graphic design.

* Logo design.

* Daily Canva production.

* Video editing and animation.

* Advanced website development.

* Daily social media posting.

* Photography and videography.

* Large-scale content repurposing.

* Routine client fulfillment.

* Technical integrations.

* Repetitive administrative production.



The goal is to hire a marketing and growth leader — not a production coordinator handling every flyer, website edit, or social media request.



## Required Qualifications



* 5+ years of experience in marketing, account management, business development, consultative sales, real estate, or a related field.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience developing marketing strategies, campaigns, messaging, and content.

* Strong relationship-building and client-facing experience.

* Experience conducting discovery calls, consultations, assessments, or sales conversations.

* Comfortable proactively reaching out to agents and asking for the business when appropriate.

* Strong project management and organizational skills.

* Experience managing multiple projects, clients, stakeholders, team members, or contractors.

* Strong copywriting, storytelling, editing, and messaging skills.

* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

* Ability to work independently and follow through without constant supervision.

* Comfortable balancing relationship-building with revenue and performance expectations.

* Comfortable working in a fast-moving remote environment.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience in real estate, a brokerage, real estate team, marketing agency, coaching company, or membership organization.

* Knowledge of real estate agent marketing, personal branding, recruiting, retention, database marketing, and lead generation.

* Experience selling marketing, branding, website, consulting, or content services.

* Experience onboarding clients into recurring service packages.

* Familiarity with Lofty, Squarespace, 
, Circle, Canva, CRM systems,
 marketing platforms, and social media tools.

* Experience managing virtual assistants, designers, developers, editors, contractors, or creative teams.

* Basic website management experience.

* Experience tracking marketing, sales, engagement, retention, and revenue metrics.

* Experience using AI for research, writing, planning, content development, analysis, or workflow improvement.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is strategic, proactive, relationship-driven, and commercially aware.



They can develop a company-wide marketing strategy while also speaking directly with an individual agent about their business and marketing needs.



They proactively reach out, identify opportunities, recommend solutions, follow up, and ensure commitments are completed.



They are comfortable conducting consultations, recommending services, asking for the sale, onboarding clients, and coordinating a fulfillment team.



They understand that marketing is not simply creating graphics or posting content. Marketing should strengthen relationships, communicate value, generate opportunities, and support measurable business outcomes.



## Key Performance Measures



* Agent conversations and marketing consultations.

* Consultation follow-up completion.

* New-agent marketing onboarding completion.

* Agent satisfaction and engagement.

* Marketing services discovery calls and proposals.

* Discovery-to-enrollment conversion rate.

* New recurring and one-time revenue.

* Active clients, retention, renewals, and cancellations.

* Client onboarding completion and first-30-day experience.

* Marketing campaign performance.

* Training registrations and attendance.

*
, website, and community engagement.

* On-time project completion.

* Quality and organization of marketing workflows.

* Development of repeatable marketing systems.



## First 90 Days



### First 30 Days — Learn & Audit



* Learn the Company’s business model, brand, agents, systems, services, and culture.

* Meet with leadership, operations, recruiting, brokerage, marketing team members, and agents.

* Review current websites, campaigns,
s, social media, community platforms, YouTube, and marketing workflows.

* Learn all marketing services, pricing, processes, and fulfillment standards.

* Review the sales pipeline, active clients, onboarding process, and fulfillment workflows.

* Identify immediate marketing, sales, onboarding, communication, and operational gaps.

* Establish baseline performance metrics.



### Days 31–60 — Build the Foundation



* Establish a consistent agent outreach and consultation process.

* Create a repeatable marketing audit and recommendation process.

* Improve the marketing services sales pipeline and tracking system.

* Document client onboarding and handoff processes.

* Establish marketing, content, training, and communication calendars.

* Improve how marketing resources and services are introduced to agents.

* Begin consistent proactive agent outreach.

* Identify priority campaigns for recruiting, retention, training, culture, and revenue growth.



### Days 61–90 — Launch & Improve



* Present and execute a prioritized quarterly marketing plan.

* Launch priority marketing and growth campaigns.

* Begin reporting marketing, sales, agent engagement, and revenue metrics.

* Recommend improvements to services, positioning, onboarding, fulfillment, and client experience.

* Establish a consistent reporting process.

* Clarify responsibilities across strategy, sales, onboarding, project management, and production.

* Identify additional staffing, contractor, system, or training needs.

* Provide leadership with a clear assessment of what is working, what needs improvement, and recommended next steps.

title: E-Commerce Manager – Marketplace Operations, Order Management & Growth
description:
/ Anything Supplies Pty Ltd



With clear performance-based growth depending on results, platform sales, GMV growth, customer reviews, operational performance, and leadership capability.



Job Description



We are launching 
, a new B2C e-commerce marketplace and app designed to scale across the Philippines, USA, Canada, Australia, Fiji, and eventually global markets.



This is not a simple e-commerce assistant role. We are looking for a hands-on E-Commerce Manager who can help manage the day-to-day operations of our platform, including product listings, order placement, order management, customer experience, campaign execution, supplier coordination, and performance reporting.



The right person must be proactive, organised, commercially aware, and able to work in a fast-moving environment. You will work closely with our marketing, logistics, sourcing, customer service, and development teams to help build a strong e-commerce operation from the ground up.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to grow with the business and potentially lead a larger e-commerce team in the future.



Key Responsibilities



Manage daily e-commerce operations across the website, app, marketplace systems, customer orders, product listings, suppliers, and campaign activities.



Oversee order placement and order management, ensuring customer orders are processed correctly, supplier/vendor orders are placed accurately, fulfilment is tracked, and delivery issues are followed up until resolved.



Monitor all active orders daily, including pending orders, supplier confirmations, dispatch status, tracking updates, delayed orders, cancelled orders, returns, refunds, and customer complaints.



Clean up and optimise product listings, including titles, descriptions, images, pricing, categories, product tags, keywords, and conversion-focused content.



Work with the marketing team to execute campaigns such as 11.11, 12.12, Black Friday, Christmas promotions, launch campaigns, product pushes, and seasonal offers.



Use competitor research and market data to recommend which products should be promoted, featured, bundled, discounted, or pushed on the homepage.



Coordinate with suppliers, vendors, logistics providers, dropshipping partners, customer service, marketing, and tech teams to resolve issues quickly.



Handle customer service escalations professionally and help reduce cancellations, refunds, and poor reviews by offering practical solutions such as replacement options, discount credits, wallet credits, alternative products, or future-purchase incentives.



Help build internal SOPs, playbooks, checklists, customer service scripts, order management processes, campaign workflows, and training documents.



Use ClickUp or similar project management tools to track tasks, deadlines, campaign progress, order issues, team responsibilities, and operational follow-ups.



Monitor and report key KPIs, including GMV, sales, conversion rate, abandoned carts, product performance, customer reviews, Google Reviews, cancellations, refunds, delayed orders, delivery issues, and campaign results.



Work with the development team to provide feedback on website/app improvements, UI/UX issues, checkout flow, customer journey problems, product page performance, and backend improvements.



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who has experience with platforms such as Shopify, WooCommerce, Lazada, Shopee, TikTok Shop, Amazon, or other e-commerce platforms.



You must understand e-commerce operations, product listings, order processing, customer service, fulfilment, returns, refunds, supplier follow-ups, and online campaign execution.



You should be able to think commercially, not just follow instructions. We need someone who can identify problems, suggest improvements, protect the customer experience, and help grow sales.



Required Skills



E-commerce operations

Order placement and order management

Order tracking and fulfilment coordination

Product listing optimisation

Marketplace management

Supplier and vendor follow-up

Campaign execution

Competitor research

Sales and conversion improvement

Google Sheets / Excel reporting

ClickUp or project management tools

SOP and playbook documentation

Strong written English communication

Problem-solving and follow-up discipline



First 30, 60 and 90 Day Expectations



First 30 Days:

Understand the platform, review product listings, learn the order process, organise ClickUp workflows, identify operational gaps, monitor active orders, and prepare an improvement plan.



First 60 Days:

Improve product listing quality, strengthen order tracking, support campaign execution, create daily/weekly reporting, document workflows, and help reduce delays, cancellations, and customer complaints.



First 90 Days:

Help build a repeatable e-commerce operating system, improve customer experience, support GMV and sales growth, reduce refund risks, improve campaign execution, and prepare the department for future team expansion.



What We Offer



Long-term opportunity with a growing Australian-owned business.



Opportunity to join at the foundation stage of a major e-commerce platform rollout.



Clear performance-based salary progression.



Opportunity to grow into a senior leadership role as the platform expands.



A fast-moving, ambitious, international business environment.

title: Direct Response Creative Director - Health & Wellness E-commerce
description:
We are an established and growing direct-response e-commerce brand in the health and wellness/supplement space, primarily operating across Australia and New Zealand, with plans for further international expansion.



We are looking for an exceptional full-time Creative Director / Creative Strategist to join our team long-term and take ownership of our paid advertising creative strategy.



This is not a traditional branding-focused Creative Director position.



We are looking for someone who is obsessed with understanding customers, their problems, desires and buying psychology — and translating those insights into compelling direct-response advertising concepts.



The goal is for you to become an expert on our products, our customers and our market, and consistently uncover new ways to position our products as the ideal solution to the problems our customers are experiencing.



What You’ll Be Responsible For

Customer & Market Research



You will conduct deep research into our customer avatars to understand:



Their primary problems and pain points

Symptoms and frustrations they experience

Emotional drivers behind their purchasing decisions

Solutions they have already tried

Why previous solutions may have failed

Objections and concerns preventing them from purchasing

Desired outcomes and transformations

The language customers naturally use when describing their problems



Research may involve customer reviews, competitor reviews, forums, social media comments, communities, customer feedback, existing brand data and other sources of customer insight.



The objective is to continually uncover new insights that can become advertising angles, hooks, mechanisms and concepts.



Competitor & Creative Research



Regularly analyse advertising from:



Direct competitors

Adjacent health and wellness brands

Leading direct-response e-commerce brands

Completely different industries where creative strategies could be adapted to our market



We are not looking to simply copy competitors.



We want someone who can recognise the underlying psychology behind successful advertising and determine how those ideas, structures and concepts could inspire something original for our products.



Angle & Mechanism Development



A major part of your role will be identifying new ways to position our products.



This includes developing:



New customer pain-point angles

Problem mechanisms

Solution mechanisms

Unique product positioning

Awareness-level-specific messaging

Objection-handling concepts

Educational concepts

Product comparison concepts

Customer story concepts

New hooks and creative narratives



You should constantly be asking:



What new reason can we give this customer to believe our product could solve their problem?



Video Ad Concepts & Scriptwriting



You will take research and strategic insights and turn them into complete video advertising concepts.



This includes:



Hooks

Creative concepts

Video structures

Direct-response scripts

UGC concepts

Founder/expert-style concepts

Educational ads

Problem/solution ads

Demonstration concepts

Testimonials/customer-story concepts

Visual direction and editing notes



Scripts should provide our video editors and production team with enough direction to clearly understand the intended execution.



Static & Image Advertising Concepts



You will also develop concepts for static/image advertising, including:



Headlines

Supporting copy

Visual concepts

Problem/solution graphics

Educational graphics

Product-focused concepts

Comparison concepts

Testimonial concepts

Advertorial-style concepts



You will work closely with our graphic designers to turn these concepts into finished advertisements.



Creative Direction & Production



You will work directly with our video editors, graphic designers and marketing team throughout the creative production process.



This means reviewing creative, providing feedback and ensuring the final execution accurately reflects the original strategy and concept.



We are looking for someone who can own creative from idea through to finished advertisement, rather than simply handing over a script and moving on.



Creative Testing & Iteration



You will help maintain a structured pipeline of new creative tests.



Once advertisements have been launched, you will review performance alongside the marketing team to understand:



Which hooks are working

Which angles are working

Which customer problems resonate most strongly

Which formats and creative styles perform best

Where customers are dropping off

Which winning concepts should be iterated

Which failed concepts contain useful learnings



Winning concepts should then be expanded into new hooks, variations, formats and executions.



The aim is to create a continuous feedback loop:



Research → Concept → Production → Testing → Analysis → Iteration



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is highly analytical while also being extremely creative.



You should genuinely enjoy researching customers and markets and figuring out why people buy.



The ideal person will have strong experience with direct-response e-commerce advertising and understand concepts such as customer awareness levels, market sophistication, hooks, mechanisms, objections, advertorial-style messaging and response-driven copywriting.



Experience within supplements, health, wellness or other problem/solution-driven products is highly desirable.



You should also be comfortable working within the advertising and regulatory limitations that come with health-related products and understand that strong direct-response marketing does not require making irresponsible or unsupported claims.



Most importantly, we want someone who is proactive.



We do not want to provide you with every advertising idea and ask you to execute it.



We want you to constantly bring us ideas.



What Success Looks Like



Over time, you should become one of the people who understands our customer better than almost anyone else in the company.



You will build a deep understanding of:



Our products.



Our customers.



Their problems.



Their objections.



Our competitors.



Our winning advertising angles.



And the psychological reasons behind why our advertising works.



From that understanding, you will maintain a consistent pipeline of well-researched, differentiated and highly testable creative concepts for our marketing team.



This is intended to be a full-time, long-term position for someone who wants to become deeply involved with one growing brand rather than simply completing occasional freelance projects.



To Apply



Please include:



A brief explanation of your experience with direct-response e-commerce creative strategy.

Examples of advertisements, scripts or concepts you personally developed.

Examples of brands or products where you helped develop new advertising angles or positioning.

An explanation of your process for conducting customer research and turning that research into advertising concepts.

An example of how you have analysed a winning or losing advertisement and used those learnings to develop the next round of creative.

Any experience you have within health, supplements, wellness or similar problem/solution-driven markets.



Please begin your application with the word CREATIVE so we know you have read the full description.



We are looking for someone exceptional who wants to take genuine ownership of creative strategy and become an important long-term part of our marketing team.

* Altituding (health and longevity coaching)



One mission behind all of them: helping people stay healthy and capable for longer. Either by serving other practitioners (B2B) with solutions to help their clients, or directly to clients (B2C).



You helping me (and my projects) get clarity and be better organised is simply step one in giving those clients a great experience.



Here's the situation:

My technical VA, Quim (with me for three years — you'll work closely with him), and I are builders. We create and fine-tune products, film content (I want to create much more content), solve problems — and we're both not great at staying on top of the "staying organised" stuff. Things slip, get forgotten, clients don't get the best attention, leads get poor follow-up... We need someone who is already naturally organised and conscientious in their own life, and who makes sure that the things we said needed doing get processed and managed. Someone who likes systems and processes, stays on top of them, checks them, reviews things, and highlights and purges obsolete stuff.



YOUR JOB, FROM DAY ONE:

- Own the task board. Track everything, chase everyone — me included. When I'm the bottleneck, you push. This is the heart of the role.





SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES (a bonus if you already know how):

- Basic video editing and content management. Turn my raw footage into content: I want to increase my content creation, and the idea is that I stay focused on creating while you handle editing, uploading, and extracting short content from longer content (finding the gold and cutting it into YouTube videos and shorts). You'll be given time and support to improve your skills.

- Manage the inbox, the logistics of social media, launch
 campaigns and similar

- Community and client care

- Collecting and organising everything my accountant needs



WHERE IT LEADS (6–18 MONTHS):

Each person is unique, with strengths and weaknesses. As we work together and get to know each other, your role will evolve to suit your best skills and capabilities. Right now, the biggest need is an overall organiser and project manager. If all goes well — you're sharp, effective and on top of things — you'll evolve to become the general manager or operations manager. The team will grow to meet the needs of the business, so your role will probably specialise more over time.



As it becomes clear where your strengths lie, you'll be trained in the areas that will make you more effective. I'd rather grow the business from within and raise the people I've built a trusting relationship with over the years.



Pay: PHP 25,000–40,000/month to start— 13th month, PH holidays plus your birthday off, paid via Wise bank transfers. (+ Bonuses when I'm impressed)

(* depends on the value/help added in the beginning. Early phases are often more about learning than adding value, which is completely normal. Each person is different and has different skills and experience. Pay will adapt to value added)



Initially, we start with a few paid test tasks, then a trial day, week, and month. Finding the right person, the right fit, is key for all of us.



DON'T APPLY TO PLEASE ME.

I've read a thousand "hardworking, detail-oriented" letters. I'm not hiring words — I'm hiring the person who already keeps lists nobody asked for, notices loose ends, asks questions, and finishes things. If you're between gigs, keeping side clients, or the type who vanishes when work gets intense, this isn't your job. If you want a long-term home — where mistakes are fixed by talking, never by disappearing — the ceiling is genuinely high. Keep reading.



Share your DISC results, IQ score, and any other qualifications you have. I'm not looking for qualifications; I'm looking for someone with the right character: honest, conscientious, sharp. But if you have qualifications or past experience of any type that shows me the skills and kind of person you are, please do share. And if you're 18 and your only work experience is helping organise your church or local association — that's fine.



TO APPLY:

1. Use 8 apply points.

2. Subject line: "Right Hand VA — [your name]"

3. In under 150 words: show me evidence, not adjectives, that you're the person described above. The word "passionate" is banned. Also, I love fruit — tell me your favourite local fruit and how much it costs where you live.

4. Also tell me what equipment you work on, include a screenshot of your internet speed, and say how often you have power or internet outages.

________________________

In Short:

Ops Assistant — evolving to Ops Manager when you're ready

Video Editor

Amazon Product Sourcing VA – Experienced Amazon FBA Sourcing Specialist



Location: Remote

Hours: 8-10 hours per day, full-time

Pay: $500/month to the right candidate + potential performance-based commissions

Industry: Amazon FBA / E-commerce



We are looking for an experienced Amazon Product Sourcing VA to join our growing e-commerce team.



This is not a basic VA role. We are looking for someone who understands Amazon product sourcing, profitability, competition and product analysis and can consistently identify genuine opportunities for us to buy and resell profitably.



The right person will become an important part of our team and will have the opportunity to take on more responsibility and earn additional commission as we grow.



What you'll be doing



Your primary responsibility will be to source profitable Amazon products and suppliers.



This will include:



Finding profitable products suitable for Amazon FBA

Conducting online arbitrage and retail arbitrage sourcing

Identifying wholesale opportunities

Finding new suppliers, retailers and potential sourcing leads

Analysing products for profitability before presenting them

Checking Amazon competition and Buy Box dynamics

Monitoring price history and sales trends

Identifying products with strong sales potential and healthy margins

Finding repeatable products that can be replenished

Researching competitors and their product ranges

Building and maintaining supplier/product databases

Contacting suppliers where required

Keeping accurate sourcing records

Continuously looking for new and creative sourcing methods

SellerAmp

SmartScout

Keepa

Amazon product research tools

Google Sheets / Excel

Sales rank

Price history

Competition

FBA fees

ROI

Profit margins

Estimated sales

Seller count

Stock levels

Keepa charts

Product restrictions / eligibility

Amazon presence on listings

Whether a product is genuinely worth sourcing



We're looking for someone who can look at a product and quickly determine:



“Is this actually worth buying, and why?”



rather than simply sending us a list of products.



We want someone who goes beyond the obvious



We are particularly interested in someone who can think creatively about sourcing.



We don't want someone who relies on one sourcing method every day.



We want someone who is constantly thinking:



Where else can we find this product?

Can we negotiate better pricing?

Can we find products before competitors do?

Can we identify new brands entering the market?

Can we find replenishable products?

As the business grows, we will be testing and developing new sourcing methods and strategies, and we want someone who is excited to be part of that process.

We want someone who:



Has genuine Amazon FBA sourcing experience

Has excellent attention to detail

Can work independently without constant supervision

We are looking for someone who thinks like a business owner, not someone who simply completes a checklist.



Working with our team



You will be working closely with our existing team and will be expected to integrate into the business, communicate regularly and contribute ideas.



We value people who take ownership of their work.



If you discover a better sourcing method, a new supplier, a better way of analysing products or an opportunity we haven't considered, we want you to bring it to the team.

title: YouTube Video Editor for Talking Head Videos with Motion Graphics
description:
We are a Dutch e-commerce company building out our YouTube channel. Our videos are talking head style with a clear story, and the editing is what makes them work. Think of the way Alex Hormozi's videos are cut. Someone talking to camera, and around that a constant layer of motion graphics, animated text, b-roll and visual proof that keeps the viewer watching to the end.



We are looking for one editor who owns this from raw footage to publish ready file. You get the footage and the script, you deliver the finished video and the thumbnail.



What you will do



Edit long form YouTube videos of maximum 10 minutes from raw talking head footage

Build motion graphics, animated text and transitions that carry the story instead of decorating it

Visualize what is being said. When the script says "you see on screen a ..." the right visual appears at the right second and it looks clean

Replace backgrounds and change the full setting of a shot when the story calls for a different environment

Generate and integrate AI images and AI visuals so they blend with the real footage

Design a simple thumbnail for each video. This is a small part of the job, editing is the main work

Handle sound design, music, color and captions so the video is ready to publish



What we are looking for



A strong portfolio of talking head videos with heavy motion graphics. This is the most important requirement. Applications without a portfolio are not reviewed

Advanced Premiere Pro or Final Cut, plus After Effects for motion graphics

Real experience with background replacement, masking, keying and rotoscoping

Working knowledge of AI image and video tools such as Midjourney, ChatGPT, Runway or Kling, and the taste to make that output look believable next to real footage

Clear written English and the discipline to hit deadlines without being chased



Nice to have



Thumbnail design in Photoshop or Canva

Experience editing for a brand channel or personal brand channel that actually grew

Understanding of YouTube retention and what makes people keep watching



How to apply



Send your application with the following.



A link to your portfolio with at least two talking head videos you edited yourself, with the motion graphics clearly visible

One example where you replaced a background or changed the setting of a shot, and one example where you used AI generated visuals inside an edit

A short note on which tools you use and how long you normally need for a 10 minute video

Start your message with the word GRAPHICS so we know you read the full post

Winding Branch Ranch is a growing nonprofit agricultural resource center and farm animal sanctuary in Texas. We’re looking for a highly organized, capable Administrative & Program Assistant to help manage the communication and administrative work that keeps our organization moving.



This is not a position where you’ll do the same task every day. We need someone who can take ownership, communicate professionally, stay organized and jump into new projects as they come up.



Schedule & Compensation



Monday through Friday

9:00 AM–4:00 PM Central Time, USA

$4 USD per hour



Applicants must be available to consistently work these hours.



What You’ll Do



You’ll help manage several important areas of our organization, including:



Responding to inquiries from families, schools, volunteers and community members

Booking and coordinating birthday parties, field trips and other programs

Managing calendars, schedules, bookings and follow-ups

Responding to animal surrender, adoption and placement inquiries using our established processes

Organizing contact information, program data and administrative records

Updating spreadsheets, databases and CRM records

Sending confirmations, invoices, reminders and follow-up communications

Keeping track of outstanding inquiries so people do not fall through the cracks

Helping maintain forms, documents and internal information

Assisting with events, fundraising, volunteers and other administrative projects as needed

Who We’re Looking For



You must have excellent written and spoken English. A significant part of this position involves communicating directly with the public, so your messages need to be warm, professional, clear and grammatically correct.



We’re looking for someone who is:



Extremely organized and detail-oriented

A strong written communicator

Comfortable managing multiple conversations and projects at once

Able to follow established processes without constant supervision

Confident making decisions within clear guidelines

Proactive about following up and closing loops

Reliable and responsive

Good at identifying missing information or potential problems

Comfortable working in a small, fast-moving organization where priorities can change

Technology Skills

Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft 365

Asana

Wix

Givebutter and CRM platforms

Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel

Online calendars and booking systems

Canva

SignupGenius

Online forms, databases and cloud-based administrative tools

title: Marketing Associate (AI First)
description:

We are not looking for a particular job title on your resume. We are looking for a particular kind of person.

You will work alongside me on the marketing side of the business: getting people into our bootcamps and programs, running campaigns, building funnels and

This is an AI company. You will learn to do the job with AI rather than around it, using the same material we sell to clients. Expect to be learning constantly, and expect to be building your own tools within months.



What Matters Most:



These are the real requirements. Everything else is negotiable.



- You genuinely love AI. Not "I have used ChatGPT" — you find this stuff interesting and you have been playing with it on your own.

- Serious curiosity. When you hit something you do not understand, you go and find out.

- Strong work ethic. Small team, real ownership, nobody chasing you.

- Positive and high energy. You will be learning fast and things will change often.

- Coachable. I will be training you directly, so you need to take feedback well and act on it.



What You Will Be Doing:



Over time, and with training

title: Meta Ads Media Buyer / Ad Strategist — Home Services | $1,500 USD/Month
description:
We’re hiring a Media Buyer / Ad Strategist to join our internal team at 4th Level, a marketing agency serving residential home-service contractors in the United States.



This is an internal role for an individual. No agencies, whitelabel providers, or outsourced teams.



Our clients include concrete, roofing, gutters, remodeling, and other home-service businesses. We need someone who can manage campaigns, develop strong creative, and turn ad spend into booked estimates.



Our primary KPI is cost per booked appointment, with a target of under $75.



Cheap leads alone do not equal success. We need qualified, reachable homeowners who actually book appointments.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



Manage and optimize Meta Ads campaigns across multiple client accounts.

Research each client’s trade, market, offer, and ideal customer.

Develop creative angles, hooks, and video scripts.

Give clear direction to our creative team.

Use AI to support research, script writing, and creative testing.

Track cost per lead, lead quality, booking rate, and cost per booked appointment.

Identify why accounts are underperforming and take action to improve them.

Communicate what you’re changing, why, and what the results show.



We handle appointment setting in-house. You’ll receive direct feedback on whether leads answer, qualify, and book—and why they don’t. You must use that feedback to improve campaigns, rather than relying only on Ads Manager metrics.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Our clients are contractors paying to keep their crews busy. They are not patient with weeks of “testing” that produce no appointments.



You need to launch with a strong strategy, identify problems early, and make informed adjustments quickly. We expect purposeful testing, clear communication, and ownership of results.



You should understand how to distinguish a campaign or lead-quality issue from a follow-up or booking issue and work with our appointment-setting team to address the actual problem.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Hands-on experience managing Meta Ads for U.S. home-service businesses.

Proven experience tracking and improving booked-appointment results.

Strong direct-response copywriting and video script-writing skills.

Ability to diagnose performance problems beyond changing targeting or increasing the budget.

Experience using AI tools in your workflow.

Strong written and spoken English.

Ability to manage multiple accounts, prioritize problems, and work independently.



If your experience and reporting stop at lead volume and cost per lead, this role is not the right fit.



COMPENSATION



$1,500 USD per month.



HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject line: Media Buyer — Booked Appointments



Include the following in your application:



1. A Loom video introducing yourself and walking through your work.



Tell us about your home-services experience and show a campaign you personally managed. Explain the results, what you changed, and how those changes affected booked appointments.



2. One or two relevant case studies.



For each case study, include:



Client’s trade and campaign timeframe.

Total ad spend.

Leads generated.

Appointments booked.

Lead-to-appointment booking rate.

Cost per booked appointment.

Your specific responsibilities and changes you made.



You may redact client names and sensitive information. Screenshots showing only cheap leads or high lead volume are not sufficient.



3. Your answer to this question:



“An account is generating cheap leads, but the cost per booked appointment is too high. What do you check first, and how do you d
 what to change?”



4. Your availability, time zone, and earliest start date.



Please include your Loom and case studies in your first application. We’re looking for someone who can explain their decisions and demonstrate how their work turns advertising spend into booked estimates.

title: Spanish Phone Support
description:
Remote Bilingual Legal Intake Coordinator (English/Spanish) — Full Time, Long-Term



### About the Role

We are a busy U.S. law firm and we are building a 24/7 client-intake desk. When someone calls

our firm, they are often in a stressful legal situation and they need a calm, professional human

to answer — not a voi
. Your job is to be that human. You will answer calls live, return

missed calls fast, monitor messages and online forms, and make sure no potential client ever

falls through the cracks.



This is a long-term, full-time role with a stable schedule. We pay on time, every time, and we

invest in people who take ownership.



### What You'll Do Every Shift

- Answer incoming calls live through our internet phone system (GoTo softphone)

- Return every missed call with a callback attempt **within 2–5 minutes** — this is the most

important measure of success in this role

- Monitor and respond to voi
s and text messages

- Monitor and respond to online intake form submissions (through Clio)

- Take clear intake information: caller name, phone,
, location, type of legal matter,

urgency, and how they found us

- Enter and update every contact in our intake system so nothing is lost

- Schedule consultations on the firm calendar

- Recognize urgent matters (jail/arrest, court deadline, immigration detention, safety issue)

and escalate them immediately using our written escalation list

- Complete a written shift handoff at the end of every shift



> **Important:** You are NOT giving legal advice. You gather information and connect people to the

> right person on our legal team. We train you on exactly what to say.



### Must-Have Requirements

- **Fully fluent in BOTH English and Spanish** — speaking, listening, reading, and writing.

You will switch between languages on live calls. This is non-negotiable.

- Clear, warm, professional phone voice with a neutral accent in both languages

- Reliable high-speed internet **plus a backup internet source** (mobile hotspot or second

provider) — you cannot go offline mid-shift

- A quiet, dedicated work space with no background noise

- A working computer and a noise-cancelling headset

- Strong attention to detail and great note-taking

- Comfortable using web-based software (we train you on GoTo and Clio)

- Dependable and punctual — shifts start on time, every time

- Able to work the **same fixed schedule long-term** (see Schedule below)



### Nice to Have (Not Required)

- Prior experience in customer service, call center, reception, or virtual assistant work

- Prior experience with a law firm, medical office, or other professional services

- Experience with GoTo, RingCentral, or similar VoIP/softphone systems

- Experience with Clio, Clio Grow, or any CRM/intake software



### Schedule

This role covers 7am to 2:30pm Mountain Time, Monday through Friday (Mountain Time)

You must be able to commit to this schedule consistently. 



### Compensation

- Paid monthly, on time

- Long-term role with raises based on performance

- We are looking for someone to grow with us for years, not weeks

title: Senior CRM & AI Automation Specialist – HubSpot / Salesforce
description:
Senior CRM & AI Automation Specialist – HubSpot /

Salesforce

Employment Type: Contract

Compensation: $10–$15 USD/hour

Location: Remote

Time Zone: PST



About the Role

We are looking for a Senior CRM & AI Automation Specialist with advanced hands-on experience in 

HubSpot and Salesforce to support a client opportunity and, if the opportunity closes, lead the technical

implementation.

This role combines CRM architecture, workflow automation, system integration, AI-powered sales

automation, and client-facing technical consulting.

Initially, you will work alongside the client lead on an active opportunity to understand the client's existing

HubSpot and Salesforce environment, assess technical feasibility, identify the right solution, define the

implementation scope, and provide a realistic technical estimate/quote.

If the opportunity moves forward, you will take ownership of implementing and optimizing the CRM and

automation systems.



This is a highly hands-on role for someone who can work independently, understand complex CRM

environments, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and confidently participate in client

discovery calls.



Key Responsibilities

Client Discovery & Technical Consulting

Join client discovery calls alongside the client lead to understand their existing CRM environment,

processes, and business requirements.

Assess the client's current HubSpot and Salesforce setup, integrations, workflows, data structure,

and automation opportunities.

Determine technical feasibility and recommend practical solutions based on the client's needs.

Define implementation requirements, technical scope, dependencies, and expected outcomes.

Provide realistic implementation estimates and technical input for client proposals and quotes.

Identify additional automation opportunities while avoiding unnecessary complexity or overbuilding.



HubSpot & Salesforce Integration



Build and maintain reliable bi-directional HubSpot ↔ Salesforce integrations.

Design and manage CRM architecture, field mapping, lifecycle stages, data synchronization, routing,

and system logic.

Ensure accurate MQL → SQL → Salesforce Opportunity handoff.

Troubleshoot synchronization issues, data inconsistencies, workflow conflicts, and integration

failures.

Maintain clean and reliable CRM data across both platforms.

AI BDR & Lead Nurture Automation

Build AI-assisted BDR/SDR workflows for automated lead follow-up and qualification.

Develop automated lead nurture workflows for new inbound leads.

Build lead reactivation systems to engage dormant leads within the existing database.

Implement trigger-based or predictive lead scoring in HubSpot to identify high-quality MQLs.

Automate lead routing and escalation based on lead behavior, qualification, and scoring.

Optimize workflows to improve speed-to-lead and conversion opportunities.



Salesforce Opportunity Automation



Build and maintain Salesforce automation for stalled, delayed, or inactive opportunities.

Develop a "Linger Pipeline" nurture system to automatically follow up with prospects delayed by

budget, timing, or other factors.

Create appropriate triggers, follow-up sequences, and routing logic to minimize manual

intervention.

Monitor workflow performance and continuously optimize automation.



Content & AI Automation Support



Support automation initiatives involving the repurposing of existing YouTube/video content into 

FAQ-style SEO, AEO, and GEO content, where technically appropriate.

Help identify opportunities to use AI and automation to efficiently repurpose existing content assets.

Recommend practical solutions based on the client's existing technology stack and objectives.



Testing, Documentation & Optimization



Thoroughly test CRM integrations and automation workflows before deployment.

Document workflows, integrations, field mappings, logic, and implementation decisions.

Monitor workflow performance and troubleshoot issues.

Continuously optimize systems for reliability, scalability, and reduced manual intervention.



Essential Qualifications



Advanced hands-on experience with both HubSpot and Salesforce.

Proven experience building and maintaining bi-directional HubSpot ↔ Salesforce integrations.

Strong understanding of CRM architecture, including:

Workflow automation

Field mapping

Lifecycle stages

Data synchronization

Lead routing



CRM data structure

Experience building automated lead nurture and lead reactivation workflows.

Experience implementing AI-assisted BDR/SDR workflows for lead follow-up and qualification.

Experience building predictive or trigger-based lead scoring in HubSpot.

Strong Salesforce automation experience, particularly for stalled or delayed opportunities.

Strong understanding of the MQL → SQL → Salesforce Opportunity process.

Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex CRM and integration issues.

Client-facing and discovery-capable, with the ability to:

Participate confidently in client calls

Understand existing systems and business processes

Ask effective technical discovery questions

Recommend appropriate solutions

Scope implementation requirements

Provide realistic implementation estimates

Ability to work independently with minimal technical hand-holding.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar automation platforms.

Strong experience working with APIs and webhooks.

Experience implementing AI agents, AI BDRs, or AI SDR systems.

Experience working with B2B sales organizations and complex CRM environments.

Understanding of SEO, AEO, and GEO.

Experience transforming YouTube/video libraries into FAQ and search-focused content.

Ability to identify additional automation opportunities during technical discovery.

Strong understanding of sales operations, lead management, and revenue workflows.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured by:



Successful technical discovery and assessment of the client's existing HubSpot/Salesforce

environment.

Accurate and practical implementation plans and technical quotes.

Reliable bi-directional HubSpot ↔ Salesforce synchronization.

Faster response to new leads and improved dormant-lead reactivation.

Improved identification, scoring, and routing of qualified MQLs.

Effective automated nurture of stalled or "Linger Pipeline" opportunities.

Reduced manual CRM and sales follow-up work.

Reliable workflow and integration performance.

Clear documentation and maintainable automation systems.

Ability to deliver solutions independently and within the agreed technical scope.



What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is a senior hands-on CRM and automation specialist who understands both the

technical and business sides of revenue operations.

You should be comfortable going beyond simply executing instructions—you'll be expected to diagnose

problems, ask the right questions, recommend solutions, scope the work, and then build it.

If you have deep HubSpot and Salesforce expertise combined with AI automation, integrations, and strong

client-facing communication skills, we'd like to hear from you

title: TikTok Shop Growth Specialist — U.S. Market | Affiliate & Creator Growth
description:
Remote | 30-Day Project-Based Engagement



Schedule: Remote, with regular availability during U.S. Pacific Time (PT) business hours. Candidates must be comfortable working with a U.S.-based team and maintaining the overlap needed for day-to-day coordination.



Starbond is looking for an experienced TikTok Shop Growth Specialist to help turn an active U.S. TikTok Shop into a scalable sales channel.



This is not a TikTok Shop setup role and is not a general social media position.



Our TikTok Shop is already active. We are looking for someone with hands-on TikTok Shop experience who can identify why current traffic is not converting, implement the right growth initiatives, develop our affiliate and creator engine, and build a repeatable operating system our internal team can continue using.



The Challenge

From September 1–7, the Shop generated:

36,516 product impressions

1,770 product clicks

0 orders

$0 GMV



Our initial business target is 100 orders within the first 30 days.



The selected specialist will first evaluate the Shop and available performance data and determine what is realistically achievable, what is preventing conversion, and what should be prioritized.



What You Will Do

You will take hands-on ownership of the TikTok Shop growth initiatives, including:

Audit current TikTok Shop performance and conversion barriers

Develop and execute a prioritized growth plan

Recruit and manage TikTok Shop affiliates

Manage creator outreach, gifting, follow-up, activation, and nurture

Recruit creators who can produce effective shoppable content

Develop strategies to increase affiliate-generated content and sales

Develop a TikTok LIVE selling strategy

Identify and coordinate qualified live sellers when needed

Optimize listings, offers, promotions, campaigns, and conversion opportunities

Monitor orders, GMV, conversion, affiliate performance, and other meaningful growth indicators

Identify what is working and what needs to change

Document processes, workflows, templates, and SOPs for internal handoff



30-Day Engagement

Week 1

Audit, diagnose, and prioritize.

Understand the Shop, traffic, products, conversion path, creators, affiliates, listings, promotions, and current opportunities.



Weeks 2–4

Execute.

Run the highest-priority initiatives across affiliates, creators, shoppable content, campaigns, conversion, and LIVE selling.



End of 30 Days

Recommend what should scale and transfer the system.

We want a clear understanding of:

What generated results

What should stop

What should continue

What should scale

What processes the internal team should maintain

What We Are Looking For

You should have actual hands-on experience managing or growing TikTok Shops.

We are especially interested in candidates who can demonstrate experience with:

TikTok Shop growth

Affiliate Center and affiliate recruitment

Creator outreach and activation

Product gifting/sample campaigns

Shoppable video strategies

TikTok LIVE commerce

E-commerce conversion optimization

TikTok Shop analytics

U.S. TikTok Shop accounts

SOP and process development



Experience managing TikTok content or social media alone is not enough. We are looking for someone who understands the commerce side of TikTok and can show measurable results.



Compensation

$6–$7/hour, depending on demonstrated TikTok Shop experience and measurable results.



This is initially a 30-day project-based engagement. The purpose of the project is to establish and validate a scalable TikTok Shop growth system for the business.



To Apply

Instead of sending only a general resume, please answer the following. We will prioritize direct TikTok Shop evidence over general social media experience.



1. Direct Experience — Have you personally managed or grown a TikTok Shop? If yes, identify the market and what you personally owned.



2. Results — Give us one before-and-after example: starting monthly orders / GMV, ending monthly orders / GMV, time period, and the actions you personally implemented.



3. Diagnostic Exercise — A TikTok Shop generated 36,516 product impressions and 1,770 product clicks in 7 days, but 0 orders. Before recommending solutions, what are the first five things you would investigate, in order, and what would each tell you?



4. Hands-On Experience — Which have you personally managed: affiliates, creator outreach, gifting/samples, creator activation, shoppable videos, Shop campaigns/promotions, LIVE selling, listings, conversion optimization, or TikTok Shop analytics?



5. First 7 Days — What are your first three priorities, what would you deliberately postpone, and what result would tell you to change direction?



6. U.S. Market — Have you worked with a U.S. TikTok Shop? If yes, briefly describe your responsibilities.



7. Evidence — Please provide screenshots, dashboards, case studies, or anonymized proof of measurable TikTok Shop results where available.



Applicants with general TikTok content or social media experience but no hands-on TikTok Shop commerce experience will not be prioritized.

You will be competing against 2 other Creative Strategists for 1 month, the entire trial month is paid, and you need to create the strongest creatives and be the best-performing Creative Strategist to earn the long-term position.

title: Direct Response Video Editor (Meta / TikTok Ads)
description:
Job Overview

We are a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand looking for a sharp, conversion-focused Direct Response Video Editor for Meta 
 & Instagram) and TikTok Ads.



This is not a traditional cinema editing role. We are not looking for cinematic showreels, corporate brand hype videos, or music videos. We need a visual marketer who understands direct response consumer psychology, retention graph optimization, and how to stop the scroll in the first 3 seconds.



You will collaborate directly with our Creative Strategist, taking raw UGC, product footage, AI footage, and conceptual hooks, and turning them into high-intent, high-converting video creatives that drive clicks and purchases. You understand how visual pacing, sound design, on-screen kinetic captions, and split-screen patterns keep mobile users glued to the screen.



Core Responsibilities

⚬ End-to-End Direct Response Editing: Edit high-converting video ad formats including UGC mashups, problem/solution native ads, 3-reasons-why, founder-led explainers, and TikTok-style native demos using editing tools like Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

⚬ Collaboration with Creative Strategist: Turn creative briefs, storyboards, and hook concepts into dynamic, performance-driven video assets without needing constant micro-management.

⚬ Rapid Hook & Angle Iteration: Systematically produce 3–5 alternative 3-second visual hooks for winning ad bodies to combat creative fatigue and unlock new scale.

⚬ Retention Pacing & Motion Design: Implement native captions, jump cuts, visual b-roll overlays, kinetic text, sound effects (SFX), and UI mockups that feel organic to the feed while driving urgency.

⚬ Performance Analysis: Review weekly creative metrics (3-second hook rate, hold rate/retention curves, and outbound CTR) with the team to understand why an ad won or lost, using the data to improve the next batch.



Required Qualifications & Skills

⚬ Direct Response Video Experience: Demonstrated track record editing high-converting video ads specifically for Meta and TikTok. You understand the difference between "aesthetic editing" and "selling on camera."

⚬ Software Mastery: High proficiency in video editing tools like Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

⚬ Direct Response Creative Portfolio: You have a portfolio/showcase containing active or past DTC e-commerce video ads (applications without an ad portfolio will not be reviewed).

⚬ Native Platform Literacy: You live and breathe short-form content. You know current audio trends, visual memes, capcut-style text pacing, and what makes an ad feel native rather than corporate.

⚬ Excellent English & Copy Nuance: Strong grasp of American/Western e-commerce phrasing, pacing, and on-screen hook formatting.

⚬ Reliable Workstation: Stable high-speed internet (plus a reliable backup connection) and a powerful editing rig capable of rendering and managing 4K/raw footage without bottlenecks.



Nice-to-Haves

⚬ Familiarity with creative research and swipe-file tools (Foreplay.co, TrendTrack, Meta Ad Library).

⚬ Experience with sleep-tech, consumer health, or premium home goods DTC brands.

⚬ Light motion graphics experience (creating custom UI overlays, comparison tables, or press badge popups).



How to Apply

Please include:

 1. A direct link to your video portfolio or Google Drive folder containing e-commerce direct response video ads you personally edited (do not send cinematic reels or corporate video work).

 2. The video editing software and computer specs you use.
