title: Floor Plan Quality Reviewer (Remote, Full Time)
description:
About the role

Roomio customers scan a property with their phone and receive a finished floor plan drawn by our design team. You will be the final check on every floor plan before it goes to the customer. You compare each plan against the order, the scan and the customer’s template, then approve it, fix small issues yourself, or send it back to the design team with a clear reason.

This is a detail focused, checklist driven role at a steady pace. You need to spot a wrong label, a missing element or a measurement that does not add up, quickly and consistently, all shift long.



What you will do

- Review every floor plan before release: template followed, property title and address correct, room labels correct, metric or imperial as the customer requested, site plan included when required, measurements consistent, floor count and orientation match the scan, legend and file format correct.

- Approve plans that pass. Fix small issues yourself in Adobe Illustrator or Photoshop (labels, address, title, legend, units). - Send plans with layout, measurement or template faults back to the design team with a reason code.

- Prioritise the queue so that express orders and orders close to their deadline are checked first.

- Open the 3D scan when something looks wrong and confirm whether the fault is in the drawing or the scan.

- Log every defect you find by category so we can see what is recurring.

- Join a short weekly review with the Product Manager on recurring issues and suggest fixes.

- Flag repeat problems that our automated checks should catch in future.



What you will not do

- Customer support or customer contact. Our customer service team handles that.

- Chasing late orders. That is handled elsewhere.



Requirements

- Experience drafting or checking real estate floor plans. You can read a floor plan the way a drafter does.

- Competent in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, editing vector floor plan files quickly and accurately.

- Comfortable working through a high volume of plans against a fixed checklist without losing accuracy.

- Able to read a 3D scan or virtual tour well enough to check layout and measurements against the plan.

- Clear written English. Your reject notes must be short and specific.

- Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for the full shift, every shift.

- Available Tuesday to Saturday, 6:00am to 2:00pm Melbourne time.



Nice to have

- Experience in a QA, inspection or production role with deadlines.

- Familiarity with LiDAR scanning apps

- Comfortable using admin web portals and dashboards.

- Experience giving structured feedback to a design or drafting team.



Tools you will use

Roomio order portal, supplier portal, scan viewer, Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, Slack, Notion.



Reporting

You report to the Product Manager and receive technical training from our CTO.



How to apply

Send your CV plus two examples of real estate floor plans you have drafted or checked. In your application, name three things you would check first on a floor plan before it goes to a customer.

title: AI Video Editor & Creative Producer – Meta Ads E-commerce
description:
AI META ADS VIDEO EDITOR & CREATIVE PRODUCER – D2C E-COMMERCE



We are Aurella, a growing D2C brand advertising in the Netherlands and Belgium.



We are looking for a full-time AI Video Editor / Creative Producer who understands direct-response Meta Ads.



This is NOT just a basic video editing role.



We will provide you with detailed SOPs, hooks, angles, scripts, references and creative directions.



Your job is to turn these instructions into high-quality finished Meta Ads.



SOP + Hook + Angle + Script + References → AI Prompts → Assets → Editing → Finished Ad



YOUR ROLE



You will create:



* TOF videos to stop the scroll and attract new customers

* MOF videos to educate, build trust and handle objections

* UGC-style ads

* Testimonial ads

* Problem/solution creatives

* Educational/mechanism ads

* AI-assisted creatives

* Animated creatives and motion graphics

* Variations of winning ads



You should be comfortable creating a lot of visually engaging animation-based creatives, not only standard UGC edits.



AI EXPERIENCE



Strong AI experience is very important.



You should be comfortable using tools such as:



ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Google Flow, Veo, Kling, Higgsfield, Runway, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, CapCut AI, Canva AI or similar tools.



You should know how to use AI for:



* Video generation

* Image generation

* Animation

* B-roll

* Voiceovers

* Creating strong AI prompts

* Creative production

* Faster ad production



You do NOT need to create the main creative strategy yourself. We provide the SOP, angle, hook, script and direction. You need to execute it accurately and creatively.



CREATIVE OUTPUT



We want a high-volume creative production system.



We expect a minimum of approximately 3 video creatives per day, with the goal of scaling up to 50 creative outputs/variations per day depending on the complexity.



This can include:



* Complete new creatives

* Hook variations

* First-frame variations

* Different animations

* Different B-roll

* CTA variations

* Different visual executions



Quality and speed are both very important.



REQUIREMENTS



* Experience editing Meta Ads for D2C/e-commerce

* Understanding of TOF and MOF creatives

* Strong direct-response editing knowledge

* Strong AI experience

* Strong animation / motion creative skills

* Experience with UGC and conversion-focused ads

* Good English

* Fast and reliable

* Detail-oriented

* Able to follow detailed SOPs accurately

* Able to work independently

* 30–40 hours per week

* Looking for a long-term position



Our ads are mainly in Dutch for the Netherlands and Belgium.



You do NOT need to speak Dutch fluently, but you must copy all Dutch text and subtitles exactly as provided.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer:



1. How many years of Meta Ads editing experience do you have?

2. Which e-commerce brands have you worked with?

3. Send your 3 best Meta Ads.

4. Send examples of animated or AI-generated creatives you have made.

5. Which AI tools do you use?

6. Have you worked with Google Flow, Veo, Kling or Higgsfield?

7. How many quality video creatives can you realistically produce per day?



Start your application with:



AURELLA CREATIVE



This tells us you actually read the entire job post.



Shortlisted candidates will receive a small PAID creative test before we make a final hiring decision.



We pay for your time.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term position and wants to grow together with our company.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
Remote Full-Stack Developer: Build a Custom CRM for a London Property Management Company



The project



We're looking for an experienced full-stack developer to design and build a custom CRM system from scratch. You'll work remotely and directly with our London team to understand our processes, then turn them into a fast, reliable, easy-to-use platform our staff will use every day.



The system will cover:



Rent roll: a clear view of every property, tenant, rent amount, due date, and payment status, with arrears flagged automatically

Maintenance: logging repair and maintenance requests, assigning contractors, and tracking each job through to completion

Task tracker: creating, assigning, and following up on tasks across the team, with due dates and reminders

Compliance tracking: storing gas safety certificates, EICRs, EPCs, deposit protection, Right to Rent checks, and licences, with alerts before anything expires

Landlord statements: automatically generating monthly statements showing rent collected, fees, and maintenance costs

Communication log: recording every
, call note, and message against the right tenant, landlord, or property

Document storage: keeping tenancy agreements, inventories, certificates, and ID documents in one place, linked to each property and tenant

Automated reminders: sending rent due reminders and arrears chasers to tenants by
 or text

Tenant and landlord portals: tenants can report repairs and view payments, and landlords can view statements and documents

Contractor management: a directory of contractors with trades and rates, plus tracking of quotes, invoices, and spend per property

Inspections: scheduling property inspections and completing them on a mobile phone, with photos saved to the property record

Accounting integration: connecting with Xero or QuickBooks

Bank integration: connecting to our bank account so rent payments are matched to tenants automatically

Lettings pipeline: tracking empty properties, applicants, viewings, and referencing

Management dashboard: arrears, empty properties, open maintenance jobs, and upcoming expiries at a glance



For reference, we like the way platforms such as Arthur Online and The Wyze work. Please take a look at both to get a feel for the kind of functionality we want. We're not looking for a copy of either, but a system built specifically around how our business runs.



What we need from you



We are looking for someone who is truly excellent at what they do. You must have:



Proven experience building CRM systems. Please show us examples of CRMs you have built, with live links, screenshots, or a portfolio.

Strong back-end skills, such as Node.js, Python/Django, PHP/Laravel, 
, plus solid database design using PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar

Strong front-end skills, such as React, Vue, or Angular, with an eye for clean, simple interfaces

Experience building and connecting APIs and third-party integrations

A good understanding of data security and privacy, as our data is covered by UK GDPR

Experience deploying and maintaining apps in the cloud, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud

The ability to manage the project from planning through to launch

Good written and spoken English, reliable internet, and clear, regular communication



Nice to have: experience with property management or real estate software, and experience with Open Banking, bank feeds, or accounting software integrations.



We look forward to hearing from you!
